#!/bin/bash

# Description: Generates random DNA sequences
# Usage: ./generate_dna.sh <length>
# Example: ./generate_dna.sh 10
# Output: Random DNA sequence

# Input validation
if [ -z "$1" ] || ! [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Error: Please provide a valid length."
    exit 1
fi

length=$1

# Generate sequence using random nucleotides
sequence=""
for (( i=0; i<length; i++ )); do
    # Generate random number between 0-3
    rand=$((RANDOM % 4))
    case $rand in
        0) sequence+="A" ;;
        1) sequence+="T" ;;
        2) sequence+="C" ;;
        3) sequence+="G" ;;
    esac
done

echo "Generated DNA: $sequence"

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Description: Identifies restriction enzyme sites (EcoRI)
# Usage: ./find_restriction_sites.sh <DNA_sequence>
# Example: ./find_restriction_sites.sh "GAATTCC"
# Output: Site positions

# Input validation
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Error: No DNA sequence provided."
    exit 1
fi

sequence="$1"

# Validate nucleotides
if ! [[ "$sequence" =~ ^[ATCG]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Error: Invalid nucleotide characters."
    exit 1
fi

# EcoRI recognition site: GAATTC
site="GAATTC"
site_length=6

# Search algorithm
positions=()
for (( i=0; i<=${#sequence}-site_length; i++ )); do
    current=$(echo "$sequence" | cut -c $((i+1))-$((i+site_length)))
    if [ "$current" = "$site" ]; then
        positions+=("$i")
    fi
done

# Output results
echo "EcoRI sites at positions: ${positions[@]}"

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Description: Compares two DNA sequences for similarity
# Usage: ./compare_sequences.sh <DNA1> <DNA2>
# Example: ./compare_sequences.sh "ATGC" "ATCC"
# Output: Identity percentage

# Input validation
if [ -z "$1" ] || [ -z "$2" ]; then
    echo "Error: Please provide two DNA sequences."
    exit 1
fi

seq1="$1"
seq2="$2"

# Length check
if [ ${#seq1} -ne ${#seq2} ]; then
    echo "Error: Sequences must be equal length."
    exit 1
fi

# Validate nucleotides
if ! [[ "$seq1" =~ ^[ATCG]+$ && "$seq2" =~ ^[ATCG]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Error: Invalid nucleotide characters."
    exit 1
fi

# Calculate identity
matches=0
for (( i=0; i<${#seq1}; i++ )); do
    if [ "${seq1:i:1}" = "${seq2:i:1}" ]; then
        ((matches++))
    fi
done

identity=$(awk "BEGIN { printf(\"%.2f\", ($matches / ${#seq1}) * 100) }")

echo "Sequence Identity: $identity%"

exit 0

text:
# General simulation settings for a molecular dynamics run
# This configuration focuses on a simple NVT ensemble for a water box.

[simulation]
name = "water_nvt_simulation"
description = "Molecular dynamics simulation of a water box in NVT ensemble."
output_directory = "./output/water_nvt"

[system]
molecule_file = "water.gro"  # GROMACS structure file
topology_file = "water.top"  # GROMACS topology file
number_of_molecules = 500
box_dimensions = [3.0, 3.0, 3.0] # nm, cubic box

[integrator]
type = "leapfrog" # Velocity Verlet or Leapfrog are common
step_size = 0.002 # ps
number_of_steps = 500000 # Total steps, 1 ns simulation

[thermostat]
type = "nose_hoover" # Nose-Hoover or V-rescale
temperature = 300.0 # K
time_constant = 0.5 # ps

[barostat]
enabled = false # NVT ensemble, so no barostat

[force_field]
name = "charmm36m" # Common force field for biomolecules
cutoff_coulomb = 1.0 # nm
cutoff_vdw = 1.0 # nm
long_range_coulomb = "pme" # Particle Mesh Ewald for long-range electrostatics
pme_grid_spacing = 0.12 # nm

[constraints]
enabled = true
type = "shake" # SHAKE for hydrogen bonds

[output]
coordinates_frequency = 1000 # steps, save coordinates every 2 ps
velocities_frequency = 0 # Do not save velocities frequently
energies_frequency = 100 # steps, save energies every 0.2 ps
log_frequency = 100 # steps, log to console

[analysis]
calculate_rdf = true
rdf_pairs = [["OW", "OW"], ["OW", "HW"]]
calculate_msd = true
msd_selection = "water"

# Advanced settings (optional)
[advanced]
seed = 12345 # Random seed for reproducibility
restart_file = "previous_run.cpt" # Checkpoint file for restarting

text:
# Configuration for a quantum chemistry calculation using DFT
# This example focuses on optimizing the geometry of a small molecule.

[calculation]
name = "formaldehyde_optimization"
description = "Geometry optimization of formaldehyde using DFT."
output_directory = "./output/h2co_opt"

[molecule]
formula = "CH2O"
charge = 0
multiplicity = 1
coordinates_format = "xyz"
coordinates = """
3
Formaldehyde molecule
C  0.00000  0.00000  0.00000
O  1.20000  0.00000  0.00000
H -0.50000  0.80000  0.00000
H -0.50000 -0.80000  0.00000
"""

[method]
type = "dft"
functional = "b3lyp" # Common hybrid functional
basis_set = "6-31g*" # Pople basis set

[optimization]
enabled = true
optimizer_algorithm = "bfgs" # Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno
max_iterations = 200
convergence_criteria = {
    energy = 1e-6, # Ha
    gradient = 1e-4, # Ha/Bohr
    displacement = 1e-3 # Bohr
}

[solvation]
enabled = false # No solvation model for this calculation

[output]
log_file = "h2co_opt.log"
geometry_file = "optimized_h2co.xyz"
hessian_file = "h2co_hessian.fchk" # For vibrational analysis

[resources]
processors = 8
memory = "16GB"

# Advanced settings for DFT
[dft_settings]
grid_size = "fine" # Integration grid quality
scf_convergence = 1e-7 # SCF energy convergence
max_scf_iterations = 100

[vibrational_analysis]
enabled = true # Calculate frequencies after optimization

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Ideal Gas Law Calculator
Demonstrates thermodynamic calculations with proper unit handling.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional
import math

# Universal gas constant in various units
R_J_MOL_K = 8.314    # J/(mol·K)
R_L_ATM_MOL_K = 0.08206  # L·atm/(mol·K)
R_CAL_MOL_K = 1.987  # cal/(mol·K)

STP_TEMPERATURE_K = 273.15  # Standard Temperature (K)
STP_PRESSURE_ATM = 1.0      # Standard Pressure (atm)
MOLAR_VOLUME_STP = 22.414   # L/mol at STP


class PressureUnit(Enum):
    ATM = "atm"
    PA = "Pa"
    KPA = "kPa"
    BAR = "bar"
    MMHG = "mmHg"


class TemperatureUnit(Enum):
    KELVIN = "K"
    CELSIUS = "C"
    FAHRENHEIT = "F"


def convert_temperature(value: float, from_unit: TemperatureUnit,
                        to_unit: TemperatureUnit) -> float:
    """Convert temperature between units."""
    # First convert to Kelvin
    if from_unit == TemperatureUnit.CELSIUS:
        kelvin = value + 273.15
    elif from_unit == TemperatureUnit.FAHRENHEIT:
        kelvin = (value - 32) * 5 / 9 + 273.15
    else:
        kelvin = value

    if kelvin < 0:
        raise ValueError("Temperature cannot be below absolute zero (0 K)")

    # Convert from Kelvin to target
    if to_unit == TemperatureUnit.CELSIUS:
        return kelvin - 273.15
    elif to_unit == TemperatureUnit.FAHRENHEIT:
        return (kelvin - 273.15) * 9 / 5 + 32
    return kelvin


def convert_pressure(value: float, from_unit: PressureUnit,
                     to_unit: PressureUnit) -> float:
    """Convert pressure between units."""
    # Convert to atm first
    to_atm = {
        PressureUnit.ATM: 1.0,
        PressureUnit.PA: 9.8692e-6,
        PressureUnit.KPA: 9.8692e-3,
        PressureUnit.BAR: 0.98692,
        PressureUnit.MMHG: 1.31579e-3,
    }
    from_atm = {unit: 1.0 / factor for unit, factor in to_atm.items()}

    atm_value = value * to_atm[from_unit]
    return atm_value * from_atm[to_unit]


@dataclass
class GasState:
    """Represents the thermodynamic state of an ideal gas."""
    pressure_atm: float
    volume_L: float
    temperature_K: float
    moles: float

    def validate(self):
        """Validate physical constraints."""
        if self.pressure_atm <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Pressure must be positive")
        if self.volume_L <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Volume must be positive")
        if self.temperature_K <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Temperature must be above absolute zero")
        if self.moles <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Number of moles must be positive")

    def pv_nrt_check(self) -> float:
        """Verify PV = nRT, return deviation percentage."""
        pv = self.pressure_atm * self.volume_L
        nrt = self.moles * R_L_ATM_MOL_K * self.temperature_K
        return abs(pv - nrt) / nrt * 100


def solve_ideal_gas(
    pressure: Optional[float] = None,
    volume: Optional[float] = None,
    temperature: Optional[float] = None,
    moles: Optional[float] = None,
) -> GasState:
    """
    Solve for the missing variable in PV = nRT.
    Exactly one parameter must be None.
    """
    none_count = sum(1 for v in [pressure, volume, temperature, moles] if v is None)
    if none_count != 1:
        raise ValueError("Exactly one variable must be unknown (None)")

    if pressure is None:
        pressure = moles * R_L_ATM_MOL_K * temperature / volume
    elif volume is None:
        volume = moles * R_L_ATM_MOL_K * temperature / pressure
    elif temperature is None:
        temperature = pressure * volume / (moles * R_L_ATM_MOL_K)
    else:
        moles = pressure * volume / (R_L_ATM_MOL_K * temperature)

    state = GasState(pressure, volume, temperature, moles)
    state.validate()
    return state


def main():
    """Demonstrate ideal gas law calculations."""
    print("IDEAL GAS LAW CALCULATOR (PV = nRT)")
    print("=" * 45)

    # Example 1: Find volume
    state1 = solve_ideal_gas(pressure=2.0, temperature=300.0, moles=1.5)
    print(f"\nExample 1 - Find Volume:")
    print(f"  P={state1.pressure_atm} atm, T={state1.temperature_K} K, n={state1.moles} mol")
    print(f"  V = {state1.volume_L:.4f} L")

    # Example 2: Find pressure
    state2 = solve_ideal_gas(volume=10.0, temperature=298.15, moles=0.5)
    print(f"\nExample 2 - Find Pressure:")
    print(f"  V={state2.volume_L} L, T={state2.temperature_K} K, n={state2.moles} mol")
    print(f"  P = {state2.pressure_atm:.4f} atm")

    # Temperature conversion demo
    print("\nTemperature Conversions:")
    temp_c = 25.0
    temp_k = convert_temperature(temp_c, TemperatureUnit.CELSIUS, TemperatureUnit.KELVIN)
    temp_f = convert_temperature(temp_c, TemperatureUnit.CELSIUS, TemperatureUnit.FAHRENHEIT)
    print(f"  {temp_c}°C = {temp_k:.2f} K = {temp_f:.2f}°F")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Acid-Base Equilibrium and pH Calculator
Demonstrates equilibrium constants, buffer calculations, and titration.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Tuple, List
from enum import Enum


class AcidType(Enum):
    STRONG = "strong"
    WEAK = "weak"


@dataclass
class Acid:
    """Represents an acid with its properties."""
    name: str
    formula: str
    ka: float  # Acid dissociation constant
    acid_type: AcidType

    @property
    def pka(self) -> float:
        """Calculate pKa from Ka."""
        if self.ka <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Ka must be positive")
        return -math.log10(self.ka)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name} ({self.formula}), Ka={self.ka:.2e}, pKa={self.pka:.2f}"


# Common acids database
COMMON_ACIDS = {
    'HCl': Acid('Hydrochloric acid', 'HCl', 1e7, AcidType.STRONG),
    'HNO3': Acid('Nitric acid', 'HNO3', 2.4e1, AcidType.STRONG),
    'H2SO4': Acid('Sulfuric acid', 'H2SO4', 1e3, AcidType.STRONG),
    'CH3COOH': Acid('Acetic acid', 'CH3COOH', 1.8e-5, AcidType.WEAK),
    'HF': Acid('Hydrofluoric acid', 'HF', 6.8e-4, AcidType.WEAK),
    'HCN': Acid('Hydrocyanic acid', 'HCN', 6.2e-10, AcidType.WEAK),
    'H2CO3': Acid('Carbonic acid', 'H2CO3', 4.3e-7, AcidType.WEAK),
    'H3PO4': Acid('Phosphoric acid', 'H3PO4', 7.5e-3, AcidType.WEAK),
}


def calculate_ph_strong_acid(concentration: float) -> float:
    """Calculate pH of a strong acid solution."""
    if concentration <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Concentration must be positive")
    if concentration < 1e-7:
        # Account for water autoionization
        h_plus = (concentration + math.sqrt(concentration**2 + 4e-14)) / 2
        return -math.log10(h_plus)
    return -math.log10(concentration)


def calculate_ph_weak_acid(concentration: float, ka: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate pH of a weak acid using quadratic formula.
    HA <-> H+ + A-
    Ka = [H+][A-] / [HA]
    """
    if concentration <= 0 or ka <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Concentration and Ka must be positive")

    # Quadratic: x^2 + Ka*x - Ka*C = 0
    discriminant = ka**2 + 4 * ka * concentration
    h_plus = (-ka + math.sqrt(discriminant)) / 2

    if h_plus <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid H+ concentration calculated")

    return -math.log10(h_plus)


def henderson_hasselbalch(pka: float, acid_conc: float,
                           base_conc: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate buffer pH using Henderson-Hasselbalch equation.
    pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA])
    """
    if acid_conc <= 0 or base_conc <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Concentrations must be positive")

    ratio = base_conc / acid_conc
    return pka + math.log10(ratio)


def titration_curve(acid_conc: float, acid_vol_mL: float,
                    base_conc: float, ka: float,
                    points: int = 20) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
    """
    Generate titration curve data points for weak acid vs strong base.
    Returns list of (volume_base_mL, pH) tuples.
    """
    pka = -math.log10(ka)
    moles_acid = acid_conc * acid_vol_mL / 1000
    equivalence_vol = moles_acid / base_conc * 1000  # mL

    curve_data = []
    volumes = [i * equivalence_vol * 1.5 / points for i in range(points + 1)]

    for vol_base in volumes:
        moles_base = base_conc * vol_base / 1000
        total_vol = (acid_vol_mL + vol_base) / 1000  # L

        if vol_base == 0:
            ph = calculate_ph_weak_acid(acid_conc, ka)
        elif moles_base < moles_acid:
            # Buffer region
            moles_remaining_acid = moles_acid - moles_base
            moles_conjugate_base = moles_base
            ph = henderson_hasselbalch(pka, moles_remaining_acid,
                                        moles_conjugate_base)
        elif abs(moles_base - moles_acid) < 1e-10:
            # Equivalence point: hydrolysis of conjugate base
            conj_base_conc = moles_acid / total_vol
            kb = 1e-14 / ka
            oh_minus = math.sqrt(kb * conj_base_conc)
            ph = 14 + math.log10(oh_minus)
        else:
            # Excess base
            excess_base = (moles_base - moles_acid) / total_vol
            ph = 14 + math.log10(excess_base)

        curve_data.append((vol_base, ph))

    return curve_data


def main():
    """Demonstrate acid-base calculations."""
    print("ACID-BASE EQUILIBRIUM CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # pH calculations
    print("\n--- pH Calculations ---")
    print(f"0.1 M HCl: pH = {calculate_ph_strong_acid(0.1):.2f}")
    acetic = COMMON_ACIDS['CH3COOH']
    ph_acetic = calculate_ph_weak_acid(0.1, acetic.ka)
    print(f"0.1 M Acetic acid: pH = {ph_acetic:.2f}")

    # Buffer calculation
    print("\n--- Buffer pH (Acetic acid/Acetate) ---")
    buffer_ph = henderson_hasselbalch(acetic.pka, 0.1, 0.1)
    print(f"Equal concentrations: pH = {buffer_ph:.2f} (= pKa = {acetic.pka:.2f})")

    # Titration curve
    print("\n--- Titration Curve (Acetic acid vs NaOH) ---")
    curve = titration_curve(0.1, 25.0, 0.1, acetic.ka, points=10)
    print(f"{'Vol NaOH (mL)':>15} {'pH':>8}")
    for vol, ph in curve[::2]:
        print(f"{vol:>15.2f} {ph:>8.2f}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Thermochemistry and Enthalpy Calculations
Demonstrates Hess's Law, bond energies, and calorimetry.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import math

# Standard enthalpies of formation (kJ/mol) at 298 K
STANDARD_ENTHALPIES: Dict[str, float] = {
    'H2O(l)': -285.8,
    'H2O(g)': -241.8,
    'CO2(g)': -393.5,
    'CO(g)': -110.5,
    'CH4(g)': -74.8,
    'C2H6(g)': -84.7,
    'C3H8(g)': -103.8,
    'C6H6(l)': 49.0,
    'NH3(g)': -46.1,
    'NO(g)': 90.3,
    'NO2(g)': 33.2,
    'SO2(g)': -296.8,
    'SO3(g)': -395.7,
    'HCl(g)': -92.3,
    'NaCl(s)': -411.2,
    'CaCO3(s)': -1207.6,
    'CaO(s)': -635.1,
    'H2(g)': 0.0,
    'O2(g)': 0.0,
    'N2(g)': 0.0,
    'C(s)': 0.0,
    'Na(s)': 0.0,
    'Ca(s)': 0.0,
}

# Average bond dissociation energies (kJ/mol)
BOND_ENERGIES: Dict[str, float] = {
    'H-H': 436, 'O=O': 498, 'N≡N': 945,
    'C-C': 347, 'C=C': 614, 'C≡C': 839,
    'C-H': 413, 'C-O': 358, 'C=O': 799,
    'O-H': 463, 'N-H': 391, 'N-N': 163,
    'C-N': 305, 'C=N': 615, 'C≡N': 891,
    'H-Cl': 432, 'H-F': 567, 'H-Br': 366,
    'Cl-Cl': 243, 'F-F': 155, 'Br-Br': 193,
}


@dataclass
class ThermoReaction:
    """Represents a thermochemical reaction."""
    reactants: Dict[str, float]  # formula: coefficient
    products: Dict[str, float]   # formula: coefficient
    name: str = "Reaction"

    def delta_h_formation(self) -> float:
        """
        Calculate standard enthalpy change using Hess's Law.
        ΔH°rxn = Σ(ΔHf° products) - Σ(ΔHf° reactants)
        """
        products_sum = sum(
            coeff * STANDARD_ENTHALPIES.get(formula, 0)
            for formula, coeff in self.products.items()
        )
        reactants_sum = sum(
            coeff * STANDARD_ENTHALPIES.get(formula, 0)
            for formula, coeff in self.reactants.items()
        )
        return products_sum - reactants_sum

    @property
    def is_exothermic(self) -> bool:
        return self.delta_h_formation() < 0

    @property
    def is_endothermic(self) -> bool:
        return self.delta_h_formation() > 0


@dataclass
class Calorimetry:
    """Calorimetry calculations for heat transfer."""
    mass_g: float
    specific_heat: float  # J/(g·°C)
    delta_temp: float     # °C

    def heat_transferred(self) -> float:
        """Calculate heat using q = mcΔT (in Joules)."""
        return self.mass_g * self.specific_heat * self.delta_temp

    def heat_in_kJ(self) -> float:
        return self.heat_transferred() / 1000


def kirchhoff_correction(delta_h_298: float, delta_cp: float,
                          temp_K: float) -> float:
    """
    Apply Kirchhoff's law to correct enthalpy for temperature.
    ΔH(T) = ΔH(298) + ΔCp × (T - 298)
    """
    return delta_h_298 + delta_cp * (temp_K - 298.15)


def bond_energy_estimate(bonds_broken: Dict[str, int],
                          bonds_formed: Dict[str, int]) -> float:
    """
    Estimate reaction enthalpy from bond energies.
    ΔH ≈ Σ(bonds broken) - Σ(bonds formed)
    """
    energy_broken = sum(
        count * BOND_ENERGIES.get(bond, 0)
        for bond, count in bonds_broken.items()
    )
    energy_formed = sum(
        count * BOND_ENERGIES.get(bond, 0)
        for bond, count in bonds_formed.items()
    )
    return energy_broken - energy_formed


def hess_law_combination(reactions: List[Tuple[ThermoReaction, float]]) -> float:
    """
    Combine reactions using Hess's Law.
    Each tuple contains (reaction, multiplier).
    """
    total_delta_h = sum(
        multiplier * reaction.delta_h_formation()
        for reaction, multiplier in reactions
    )
    return total_delta_h


def main():
    """Demonstrate thermochemistry calculations."""
    print("THERMOCHEMISTRY CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # Combustion of methane: CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O
    combustion = ThermoReaction(
        reactants={'CH4(g)': 1, 'O2(g)': 2},
        products={'CO2(g)': 1, 'H2O(l)': 2},
        name="Methane Combustion"
    )
    delta_h = combustion.delta_h_formation()
    print(f"\n{combustion.name}:")
    print(f"  ΔH° = {delta_h:.1f} kJ/mol")
    print(f"  {'Exothermic' if combustion.is_exothermic else 'Endothermic'}")

    # Calorimetry example

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Chemical Kinetics and Reaction Rates
Demonstrates rate laws, Arrhenius equation, and half-life calculations.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from enum import Enum

# Physical constants
R_GAS = 8.314  # J/(mol·K)


class ReactionOrder(Enum):
    ZERO = 0
    FIRST = 1
    SECOND = 2


@dataclass
class KineticsData:
    """Stores kinetic parameters for a reaction."""
    rate_constant: float      # k (units depend on order)
    order: ReactionOrder
    activation_energy: float  # Ea in J/mol
    pre_exponential: float    # A (frequency factor)
    temperature_K: float      # Reference temperature

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.rate_constant <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Rate constant must be positive")
        if self.activation_energy < 0:
            raise ValueError("Activation energy cannot be negative")
        if self.temperature_K <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Temperature must be above absolute zero")


def arrhenius_rate_constant(pre_exp: float, ea_J_mol: float,
                             temp_K: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate rate constant using Arrhenius equation.
    k = A * exp(-Ea / RT)
    """
    if temp_K <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Temperature must be positive")
    return pre_exp * math.exp(-ea_J_mol / (R_GAS * temp_K))


def arrhenius_temperature_dependence(k1: float, t1_K: float,
                                      t2_K: float, ea_J_mol: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate rate constant at new temperature using two-point Arrhenius.
    ln(k2/k1) = -Ea/R * (1/T2 - 1/T1)
    """
    ln_ratio = -ea_J_mol / R_GAS * (1/t2_K - 1/t1_K)
    return k1 * math.exp(ln_ratio)


def activation_energy_from_rates(k1: float, t1_K: float,
                                   k2: float, t2_K: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate activation energy from two rate constants at different temperatures.
    """
    if k1 <= 0 or k2 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Rate constants must be positive")
    ln_ratio = math.log(k2 / k1)
    return -R_GAS * ln_ratio / (1/t2_K - 1/t1_K)


def concentration_vs_time(initial_conc: float, rate_constant: float,
                           time: float, order: ReactionOrder) -> float:
    """
    Calculate concentration at time t for different reaction orders.
    """
    if initial_conc < 0 or time < 0:
        raise ValueError("Concentration and time must be non-negative")

    if order == ReactionOrder.ZERO:
        # [A] = [A]0 - kt
        conc = initial_conc - rate_constant * time
        return max(0.0, conc)

    elif order == ReactionOrder.FIRST:
        # [A] = [A]0 * exp(-kt)
        return initial_conc * math.exp(-rate_constant * time)

    elif order == ReactionOrder.SECOND:
        # 1/[A] = 1/[A]0 + kt
        return 1.0 / (1.0/initial_conc + rate_constant * time)

    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported reaction order: {order}")


def half_life(rate_constant: float, order: ReactionOrder,
              initial_conc: float = 1.0) -> float:
    """
    Calculate half-life for different reaction orders.
    """
    if rate_constant <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Rate constant must be positive")

    if order == ReactionOrder.ZERO:
        return initial_conc / (2 * rate_constant)
    elif order == ReactionOrder.FIRST:
        return math.log(2) / rate_constant
    elif order == ReactionOrder.SECOND:
        return 1.0 / (rate_constant * initial_conc)

    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported order: {order}")


def integrated_rate_law_plot_data(
    initial_conc: float, rate_constant: float,
    order: ReactionOrder, num_points: int = 10
) -> List[Tuple[float, float]]:
    """
    Generate data for integrated rate law plots.
    Returns (time, linearized_concentration) pairs.
    """
    t_half = half_life(rate_constant, order, initial_conc)
    times = [i * 3 * t_half / num_points for i in range(num_points + 1)]
    data = []

    for t in times:
        conc = concentration_vs_time(initial_conc, rate_constant, t, order)
        if order == ReactionOrder.ZERO:
            y = conc  # [A] vs t is linear
        elif order == ReactionOrder.FIRST:
            y = math.log(conc) if conc > 0 else float('-inf')  # ln[A] vs t
        else:
            y = 1.0 / conc if conc > 0 else float('inf')  # 1/[A] vs t
        data.append((t, y))

    return data


def main():
    """Demonstrate chemical kinetics calculations."""
    print("CHEMICAL KINETICS CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # Arrhenius equation
    print("\n--- Arrhenius Equation ---")
    ea = 75000  # J/mol
    a_factor = 1e13
    k_300 = arrhenius_rate_constant(a_factor, ea, 300)
    k_350 = arrhenius_rate_constant(a_factor, ea, 350)
    print(f"k at 300K: {k_300:.4e} s⁻¹")
    print(f"k at 350K: {k_350:.4e} s⁻¹")
    print(f"Rate ratio (350K/300K): {k_350/k_300:.2f}")

    # Half-life calculations
    print("\n--- Half-Life Calculations ---")
    for order in ReactionOrder:
        k = 0.05
        t_half = half_life(k, order, initial_conc=1.0)
        print(f"Order {order.value}: t½ = {t_half:.4f} (k={k})")

    # Concentration vs time for first-order
    print("\n--- First-Order Decay (k=0.1 s⁻¹, [A]₀=1.0 M) ---")
    print(f"{'Time (s)':>10} {'[A] (M)':>12}")
    for t in [0, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50]:
        conc = concentration_vs_time(1.0, 0.1, t, ReactionOrder.FIRST)
        print(f"{t:>10} {conc:>12.4f}")

    # Activation energy from two measurements
    ea_calc = activation_energy_from_rates(0.001, 300, 0.05, 350)
    print(f"\nCalculated Ea from rate data: {ea_calc/1000:.1f} kJ/mol")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Electrochemistry and Electrochemical Cells
Demonstrates cell potentials, Nernst equation, and electrolysis.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

# Physical constants
FARADAY = 96485.0    # C/mol
R_GAS = 8.314        # J/(mol·K)
STD_TEMP = 298.15    # K

# Standard reduction potentials (V) at 25°C
STD_REDUCTION_POTENTIALS: Dict[str, float] = {
    'F2/F-': 2.87,
    'MnO4-/Mn2+': 1.51,
    'Cl2/Cl-': 1.36,
    'Cr2O72-/Cr3+': 1.33,
    'O2/H2O': 1.23,
    'Br2/Br-': 1.07,
    'Ag+/Ag': 0.80,
    'Fe3+/Fe2+': 0.77,
    'I2/I-': 0.54,
    'Cu2+/Cu': 0.34,
    'AgCl/Ag': 0.22,
    'H+/H2': 0.00,
    'Pb2+/Pb': -0.13,
    'Sn2+/Sn': -0.14,
    'Ni2+/Ni': -0.25,
    'Fe2+/Fe': -0.44,
    'Zn2+/Zn': -0.76,
    'Al3+/Al': -1.66,
    'Mg2+/Mg': -2.37,
    'Na+/Na': -2.71,
    'Li+/Li': -3.04,
}


@dataclass
class HalfReaction:
    """Represents an electrochemical half-reaction."""
    couple: str
    electrons: int
    std_potential: float  # V
    is_reduction: bool = True

    @property
    def oxidation_potential(self) -> float:
        return -self.std_potential

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        direction = "reduction" if self.is_reduction else "oxidation"
        return f"{self.couple} ({direction}, E°={self.std_potential:.2f} V)"


@dataclass
class ElectrochemicalCell:
    """Represents a galvanic or electrolytic cell."""
    cathode: HalfReaction  # Reduction occurs here
    anode: HalfReaction    # Oxidation occurs here
    name: str = "Electrochemical Cell"

    @property
    def std_cell_potential(self) -> float:
        """E°cell = E°cathode - E°anode"""
        return self.cathode.std_potential - self.anode.std_potential

    @property
    def electrons_transferred(self) -> int:
        """Number of electrons transferred (LCM of half-reactions)."""
        from math import gcd
        n1, n2 = self.cathode.electrons, self.anode.electrons
        return n1 * n2 // gcd(n1, n2)

    @property
    def is_spontaneous(self) -> bool:
        return self.std_cell_potential > 0

    def delta_g_standard(self) -> float:
        """ΔG° = -nFE° (in Joules)"""
        n = self.electrons_transferred
        return -n * FARADAY * self.std_cell_potential

    def equilibrium_constant(self, temp_K: float = STD_TEMP) -> float:
        """K = exp(nFE° / RT)"""
        n = self.electrons_transferred
        exponent = n * FARADAY * self.std_cell_potential / (R_GAS * temp_K)
        return math.exp(exponent)


def nernst_equation(std_potential: float, n_electrons: int,
                     reaction_quotient: float,
                     temp_K: float = STD_TEMP) -> float:
    """
    Calculate cell potential using Nernst equation.
    E = E° - (RT/nF) * ln(Q)
    """
    if n_electrons <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Number of electrons must be positive")
    if reaction_quotient <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Reaction quotient must be positive")

    correction = (R_GAS * temp_K) / (n_electrons * FARADAY) * math.log(reaction_quotient)
    return std_potential - correction


def electrolysis_mass(current_A: float, time_s: float,
                       molar_mass: float, n_electrons: int) -> float:
    """
    Calculate mass deposited/dissolved during electrolysis.
    m = (I * t * M) / (n * F)
    """
    if current_A <= 0 or time_s <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Current and time must be positive")
    charge = current_A * time_s  # Coulombs
    moles = charge / (n_electrons * FARADAY)
    return moles * molar_mass


def main():
    """Demonstrate electrochemistry calculations."""
    print("ELECTROCHEMISTRY CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # Daniell cell: Zn | Zn2+ || Cu2+ | Cu
    zinc_half = HalfReaction('Zn2+/Zn', electrons=2,
                              std_potential=STD_REDUCTION_POTENTIALS['Zn2+/Zn'])
    copper_half = HalfReaction('Cu2+/Cu', electrons=2,
                                std_potential=STD_REDUCTION_POTENTIALS['Cu2+/Cu'])

    daniell = ElectrochemicalCell(
        cathode=copper_half,
        anode=zinc_half,
        name="Daniell Cell (Zn-Cu)"
    )

    print(f"\n{daniell.name}")
    print(f"  Cathode: {daniell.cathode}")
    print(f"  Anode: {daniell.anode}")
    print(f"  E°cell = {daniell.std_cell_potential:.4f} V")
    print(f"  Spontaneous: {daniell.is_spontaneous}")
    print(f"  ΔG° = {daniell.delta_g_standard()/1000:.2f} kJ/mol")
    print(f"  K = {daniell.equilibrium_constant():.4e}")

    # Nernst equation
    print("\n--- Nernst Equation ---")
    q_values = [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0]
    for q in q_values:
        e = nernst_equation(daniell.std_cell_potential, 2, q)
        print(f"  Q={q:6.2f}: E = {e:.4f} V")

    # Electrolysis
    print("\n--- Electrolysis (Cu deposition) ---")
    mass = electrolysis_mass(current_A=2.0, time_s=3600,
                              molar_mass=63.546, n_electrons=2)
    print(f"  2A for 1 hour deposits {mass:.4f} g of Cu")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Solution Chemistry and Colligative Properties
Demonstrates concentration calculations, solubility, and colligative properties.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Optional
from enum import Enum

# Physical constants
R_GAS = 0.08206  # L·atm/(mol·K)

# Solvent properties
SOLVENT_PROPERTIES: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = {
    'water': {
        'boiling_point': 100.0,   # °C
        'freezing_point': 0.0,    # °C
        'kb': 0.512,              # K·kg/mol (ebullioscopic constant)
        'kf': 1.86,               # K·kg/mol (cryoscopic constant)
        'density': 1.0,           # g/mL
        'molar_mass': 18.015,     # g/mol
    },
    'benzene': {
        'boiling_point': 80.1,
        'freezing_point': 5.5,
        'kb': 2.53,
        'kf': 5.12,
        'density': 0.879,
        'molar_mass': 78.11,
    },
    'cyclohexane': {
        'boiling_point': 80.7,
        'freezing_point': 6.5,
        'kb': 2.79,
        'kf': 20.0,
        'density': 0.779,
        'molar_mass': 84.16,
    },
}


class ConcentrationUnit(Enum):
    MOLARITY = "M"          # mol/L
    MOLALITY = "m"          # mol/kg
    MOLE_FRACTION = "χ"     # dimensionless
    MASS_PERCENT = "w/w%"   # mass percent
    PPM = "ppm"             # parts per million


@dataclass
class Solution:
    """Represents a solution with solute and solvent."""
    solute_moles: float
    solvent_kg: float
    solute_molar_mass: float  # g/mol
    solvent_name: str = 'water'
    van_hoff_factor: float = 1.0  # i (for electrolytes)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.solute_moles < 0:
            raise ValueError("Moles of solute cannot be negative")
        if self.solvent_kg <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Solvent mass must be positive")

    @property
    def solvent_props(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        return SOLVENT_PROPERTIES.get(self.solvent_name, SOLVENT_PROPERTIES['water'])

    @property
    def molality(self) -> float:
        """mol solute / kg solvent"""
        return self.solute_moles / self.solvent_kg

    @property
    def volume_L(self) -> float:
        """Approximate solution volume in liters."""
        solvent_mL = self.solvent_kg * 1000 / self.solvent_props['density']
        solute_g = self.solute_moles * self.solute_molar_mass
        return (solvent_mL + solute_g / self.solvent_props['density']) / 1000

    @property
    def molarity(self) -> float:
        """mol solute / L solution"""
        return self.solute_moles / self.volume_L

    @property
    def mole_fraction_solute(self) -> float:
        solvent_moles = (self.solvent_kg * 1000) / self.solvent_props['molar_mass']
        return self.solute_moles / (self.solute_moles + solvent_moles)

    def boiling_point_elevation(self) -> float:
        """ΔTb = i * Kb * m"""
        kb = self.solvent_props['kb']
        return self.van_hoff_factor * kb * self.molality

    def freezing_point_depression(self) -> float:
        """ΔTf = i * Kf * m"""
        kf = self.solvent_props['kf']
        return self.van_hoff_factor * kf * self.molality

    def osmotic_pressure(self, temp_K: float = 298.15) -> float:
        """π = iMRT (in atm)"""
        return self.van_hoff_factor * self.molarity * R_GAS * temp_K

    def vapor_pressure_lowering(self, pure_vp: float) -> float:
        """ΔP = χ_solute * P°_solvent (Raoult's Law)"""
        return self.mole_fraction_solute * pure_vp


def dilution_calculation(c1: float, v1: float, c2: float = None,
                          v2: float = None) -> float:
    """
    Apply dilution formula: C1V1 = C2V2.
    Provide three values, returns the fourth.
    """
    if c2 is None:
        return c1 * v1 / v2
    elif v2 is None:
        return c1 * v1 / c2
    raise ValueError("Exactly one of c2 or v2 must be None")


def main():
    """Demonstrate solution chemistry calculations."""
    print("SOLUTION CHEMISTRY CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # Create a glucose solution (C6H12O6, M=180.16 g/mol)
    glucose = Solution(
        solute_moles=0.5,
        solvent_kg=1.0,
        solute_molar_mass=180.16,
        solvent_name='water',
        van_hoff_factor=1.0
    )

    print("\nGlucose Solution (0.5 mol in 1 kg water):")
    print(f"  Molality: {glucose.molality:.4f} m")
    print(f"  Molarity: {glucose.molarity:.4f} M")
    print(f"  Mole fraction: {glucose.mole_fraction_solute:.6f}")
    print(f"  Boiling point elevation: {glucose.boiling_point_elevation():.4f} °C")
    print(f"  Freezing point depression: {glucose.freezing_point_depression():.4f} °C")
    print(f"  Osmotic pressure: {glucose.osmotic_pressure():.4f} atm")

    # NaCl solution (i ≈ 2 for strong electrolyte)
    nacl = Solution(
        solute_moles=0.1,
        solvent_kg=1.0,
        solute_molar_mass=58.44,
        solvent_name='water',
        van_hoff_factor=1.9  # Slightly less than 2 due to ion pairing
    )
    print("\nNaCl Solution (0.1 mol, i=1.9):")
    print(f"  Freezing point depression: {nacl.freezing_point_depression():.4f} °C")
    print(f"  New freezing point: {0.0 - nacl.freezing_point_depression():.4f} °C")

    # Dilution example
    print("\n--- Dilution Calculation ---")
    v2 = dilution_calculation(c1=12.0, v1=25.0, c2=0.5)
    print(f"  12.0 M HCl, 25 mL -> 0.5 M: need {v2:.1f} mL final volume")

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Chemistry Best Practices: Nuclear Chemistry and Radioactive Decay
Demonstrates decay calculations, nuclear equations, and radiation safety.
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from enum import Enum

# Physical constants
AVOGADRO = 6.022e23
AMU_TO_KG = 1.66054e-27
C_LIGHT = 2.998e8  # m/s
J_TO_MEV = 6.242e12  # 1 J = 6.242e12 MeV


class DecayMode(Enum):
    ALPHA = "α"
    BETA_MINUS = "β⁻"
    BETA_PLUS = "β⁺"
    GAMMA = "γ"
    ELECTRON_CAPTURE = "EC"
    SPONTANEOUS_FISSION = "SF"


@dataclass
class Nuclide:
    """Represents a nuclear species."""
    symbol: str
    atomic_number: int   # Z
    mass_number: int     # A
    atomic_mass_amu: float  # in atomic mass units
    half_life_s: Optional[float] = None  # None if stable

    @property
    def neutron_number(self) -> int:
        return self.mass_number - self.atomic_number

    @property
    def is_stable(self) -> bool:
        return self.half_life_s is None

    @property
    def decay_constant(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """λ = ln(2) / t½"""
        if self.is_stable:
            return None
        return math.log(2) / self.half_life_s

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"^{self.mass_number}_{self.atomic_number}{self.symbol}"


# Common nuclides database
NUCLIDES: Dict[str, Nuclide] = {
    'U-238': Nuclide('U', 92, 238, 238.0508, 1.41e17),
    'U-235': Nuclide('U', 92, 235, 235.0439, 2.22e16),
    'Th-234': Nuclide('Th', 90, 234, 234.0436, 2.08e6),
    'Ra-226': Nuclide('Ra', 88, 226, 226.0254, 5.05e10),
    'Rn-222': Nuclide('Rn', 86, 222, 222.0176, 3.30e5),
    'Po-210': Nuclide('Po', 84, 210, 209.9829, 1.20e7),
    'Pb-206': Nuclide('Pb', 82, 206, 205.9745, None),
    'C-14': Nuclide('C', 6, 14, 14.0032, 1.81e11),
    'I-131': Nuclide('I', 53, 131, 130.9061, 6.94e5),
    'Cs-137': Nuclide('Cs', 55, 137, 136.9071, 9.49e8),
    'Co-60': Nuclide('Co', 27, 60, 59.9338, 1.66e8),
    'H-3': Nuclide('H', 1, 3, 3.0160, 3.89e8),
}


def radioactive_decay(initial_atoms: float, decay_constant: float,
                       time_s: float) -> float:
    """N(t) = N0 * exp(-λt)"""
    return initial_atoms * math.exp(-decay_constant * time_s)


def activity(atoms: float, decay_constant: float) -> float:
    """A = λN (in Becquerels)"""
    return decay_constant * atoms


def atoms_from_mass(mass_g: float, molar_mass: float) -> float:
    """Calculate number of atoms from mass."""
    return (mass_g / molar_mass) * AVOGADRO


def mass_defect_and_binding_energy(
    proton_mass_amu: float, neutron_mass_amu: float,
    atomic_mass_amu: float, Z: int, N: int
) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """
    Calculate mass defect and binding energy.
    Returns (mass_defect_amu, binding_energy_MeV).
    """
    theoretical_mass = Z * proton_mass_amu + N * neutron_mass_amu
    mass_defect = theoretical_mass - atomic_mass_amu
    binding_energy_J = mass_defect * AMU_TO_KG * C_LIGHT**2
    binding_energy_MeV = binding_energy_J * J_TO_MEV
    return mass_defect, binding_energy_MeV


def radiometric_dating(measured_ratio: float, half_life_s: float) -> float:
    """
    Calculate age from isotope ratio using radiometric dating.
    t = t½ * log2(N0/N) = t½ * ln(N0/N) / ln(2)
    """
    if measured_ratio <= 0 or measured_ratio > 1:
        raise ValueError("Ratio must be between 0 and 1")
    return half_life_s * math.log(1 / measured_ratio) / math.log(2)


def main():
    """Demonstrate nuclear chemistry calculations."""
    print("NUCLEAR CHEMISTRY CALCULATOR")
    print("=" * 40)

    # Radioactive decay of C-14
    c14 = NUCLIDES['C-14']
    print(f"\nCarbon-14 Decay:")
    print(f"  Half-life: {c14.half_life_s:.3e} s ({c14.half_life_s/3.156e7:.0f} years)")
    print(f"  Decay constant: {c14.decay_constant:.4e} s⁻¹")

    initial_atoms = atoms_from_mass(1e-6, 14.003)  # 1 microgram
    print(f"  Initial atoms (1 μg): {initial_atoms:.4e}")
    initial_activity = activity(initial_atoms, c14.decay_constant)
    print(f"  Initial activity: {initial_activity:.4f} Bq")

    # After 5730 years (one half-life)
    t = 5730 * 3.156e7  # seconds
    remaining = radioactive_decay(initial_atoms, c14.decay_constant, t)
    print(f"  After 5730 years: {remaining:.4e} atoms ({remaining/initial_atoms*100:.1f}%)")

    # Radiometric dating
    print("\n--- Radiometric Dating ---")
    ratio = 0.25  # 25% of original C-14 remains
    age_s = radiometric_dating(ratio, c14.half_life_s)

CODON_TABLE: Dict[str, str] = {

    "UCU": "S", "UCC": "S", "UCA": "S", "UCG": "S",
    "CCU": "P", "CCC": "P", "CCA": "P", "CCG": "P",
    "ACU": "T", "ACC": "T", "ACA": "T", "ACG": "T",
    "GCU": "A", "GCC": "A", "GCA": "A", "GCG": "A",
    "UAU": "Y", "UAC": "Y", "UAA": "STOP", "UAG": "STOP",

}

def translate_rna_to_protein(rna_sequence: str) -> List[str]:
    """
    Translates an RNA sequence into a protein sequence.

    Args:
        rna_sequence: The RNA sequence to translate.

    Returns:
        A list of amino acid single-letter codes representing the protein.
    """
    protein_sequence: List[str] = []
    for i in range(0, len(rna_sequence) - 2, 3):
        codon = rna_sequence[i:i+3]
        amino_acid = CODON_TABLE.get(codon)
        if amino_acid == "STOP":

        elif amino_acid:
            protein_sequence.append(amino_acid)
    return protein_sequence

from typing import Tuple

def calculate_gc_content(dna_sequence: str) -> float:
    """
    Calculates the GC-content of a DNA sequence.

    Args:
        dna_sequence: The DNA sequence.

    Returns:
        The GC-content as a float (proportion).
    """
    if not dna_sequence:
        return 0.0
    gc_count = dna_sequence.count('G') + dna_sequence.count('C')
    return gc_count / len(dna_sequence)


def find_complementary_strand(dna_sequence: str) -> str:
    """
    Finds the complementary DNA strand.

    Args:
        dna_sequence: The original DNA sequence.

    Returns:
        The complementary DNA sequence.
    """
    complement_map = {'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'C': 'G', 'G': 'C'}
    complementary_strand_list = [complement_map[base] for base in dna_sequence.upper()]
    return ''.join(complementary_strand_list)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    dna = "ATGCGTACGT"
    gc = calculate_gc_content(dna)
    complement = find_complementary_strand(dna)
    print(f"DNA: {dna}")
    print(f"GC Content: {gc:.2f}")
    print(f"Complementary Strand: {complement}")

from typing import List, Tuple

def mendelian_monohybrid_cross(parent1_genotype: str, parent2_genotype: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    Simulates a monohybrid Mendelian cross and returns genotype probabilities.

    Args:
        parent1_genotype: Genotype of parent 1 (e.g., "AA", "Aa", "aa").
        parent2_genotype: Genotype of parent 2 (e.g., "AA", "Aa", "aa").

    Returns:
        A dictionary with genotype strings as keys and their probabilities as values.
    """
    alleles1 = [parent1_genotype[0], parent1_genotype[1]]
    alleles2 = [parent2_genotype[0], parent2_genotype[1]]

    offspring_genotypes: List[str] = []
    for a1 in alleles1:
        for a2 in alleles2:
            offspring_genotypes.append(''.join(sorted([a1, a2])))

    genotype_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for genotype in offspring_genotypes:
        genotype_counts[genotype] = genotype_counts.get(genotype, 0) + 1

    total_offspring = len(offspring_genotypes)
    genotype_probabilities: Dict[str, float] = {
        genotype: count / total_offspring for genotype, count in genotype_counts.items()
    }
    return genotype_probabilities


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cross_results = mendelian_monohybrid_cross("Aa", "Aa")
    print(f"Monohybrid cross (Aa x Aa) probabilities: {cross_results}")

from typing import List, Tuple

def find_restriction_sites(dna_sequence: str, recognition_sequence: str) -> List[int]:
    """
    Finds all occurrences of a restriction enzyme recognition sequence in a DNA strand.

    Args:
        dna_sequence: The DNA sequence to search within.
        recognition_sequence: The restriction enzyme recognition sequence.

    Returns:
        A list of starting indices where the recognition sequence is found.
    """
    sites: List[int] = []
    seq_len = len(dna_sequence)
    rec_len = len(recognition_sequence)

    for i in range(seq_len - rec_len + 1):
        if dna_sequence[i:i+rec_len] == recognition_sequence:
            sites.append(i)
    return sites

    print(f"DNA: {dna}")
    print(f"Recognition sequence: {eco_ri_site}")
    print(f"Found at indices: {found_sites}")

from typing import List, Tuple

def count_k_mers(sequence: str, k: int) -> Dict[str, int]:
    """
    Counts the occurrences of all k-mers in a given sequence.

    Args:
        sequence: The DNA or RNA sequence.
        k: The length of the k-mer.

    Returns:
        A dictionary where keys are k-mers and values are their counts.
    """
    if k <= 0 or k > len(sequence):
        raise ValueError("k must be a positive integer and not exceed sequence length.")

    k_mer_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for i in range(len(sequence) - k + 1):
        k_mer = sequence[i:i+k]
        k_mer_counts[k_mer] = k_mer_counts.get(k_mer, 0) + 1
    return k_mer_counts


if __name__ == "__main__":
    dna_seq = "ATGCATGCATGC"

    k_mers = count_k_mers(dna_seq, k_mer_length)
    print(f"Sequence: {dna_seq}")
    print(f"{k_mer_length}-mer counts: {k_mers}")

from typing import List, Dict, Tuple

def calculate_hardy_weinberg_genotype_frequencies(p_allele_freq: float, q_allele_freq: float) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    Calculates expected genotype frequencies under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.

    Args:
        p_allele_freq: Frequency of the dominant allele (p).
        q_allele_freq: Frequency of the recessive allele (q).

    Returns:
        A dictionary with genotype strings ("AA", "Aa", "aa") as keys and their expected frequencies as values.
    """
    if not (0 <= p_allele_freq <= 1 and 0 <= q_allele_freq <= 1 and abs(p_allele_freq + q_allele_freq - 1.0) < 1e-6):
        raise ValueError("Allele frequencies (p and q) must be between 0 and 1 and sum to 1.")

    freq_AA = p_allele_freq ** 2
    freq_Aa = 2 * p_allele_freq * q_allele_freq
    freq_aa = q_allele_freq ** 2

    return {"AA": freq_AA, "Aa": freq_Aa, "aa": freq_aa}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = 0.7  # Frequency of dominant allele
    q = 0.3  # Frequency of recessive allele
    hw_frequencies = calculate_hardy_weinberg_genotype_frequencies(p, q)
    print(f"Allele frequencies: p={p}, q={q}")
    print(f"Hardy-Weinberg genotype frequencies: {hw_frequencies}")

text:
# Example 1: Chemistry project Makefile
# Demonstrates best practices for computational chemistry workflows.
#
# Features:
# - Strict shell settings
# - Configurable directories and tools
# - Pattern rules for repeated transformations
# - Validation, simulation, analysis, and cleanup targets
# - Helpful self-documenting help target

SHELL := /bin/bash
.SHELLFLAGS := -eu -o pipefail -c
.ONESHELL:
MAKEFLAGS += --warn-undefined-variables

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

# Project metadata
PROJECT := aspirin-screen
ENV ?= dev
DATE := $(shell date +%Y%m%d)

# Directory layout
ROOT_DIR := .
DATA_DIR := data
RAW_DIR := $(DATA_DIR)/raw
PROC_DIR := $(DATA_DIR)/processed
RESULTS_DIR := results
REPORT_DIR := reports
LOG_DIR := logs
TMP_DIR := tmp
CFG_DIR := config
SCRIPT_DIR := scripts

# Tools (replace echo with real tools in production)
PYTHON ?= python3
R_SCRIPT ?= Rscript
OBABEL ?= obabel
PACKMOL ?= packmol
GROMACS ?= gmx

# Inputs
SDF_INPUTS := $(wildcard $(RAW_DIR)/*.sdf)
CSV_INPUTS := $(wildcard $(RAW_DIR)/*.csv)
MOLECULES := caffeine aspirin ibuprofen acetaminophen nicotine
PDBS := $(addprefix $(PROC_DIR)/,$(addsuffix .pdb,$(MOLECULES)))
MINIMIZED := $(addprefix $(RESULTS_DIR)/,$(addsuffix _minimized.pdb,$(MOLECULES)))
REPORTS := $(REPORT_DIR)/summary.txt $(REPORT_DIR)/qc.txt

# Chemistry parameters
PH ?= 7.4
TEMP_K ?= 298
BOX_SIZE ?= 4.0
FORCEFIELD ?= amber99sb
WATER_MODEL ?= tip3p

# Internal helper macros
define ensure_dir
	mkdir -p $(1)
endef

define log_step
	echo "[$(DATE)] $(1)" | tee -a $(LOG_DIR)/pipeline.log
endef

.PHONY: help init validate prepare simulate analyze report qc clean distclean all

help: ## Show documented targets
	@awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*## "}; /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-20s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

all: init validate prepare simulate analyze report ## Run complete chemistry workflow

init: ## Create project directories
	$(call ensure_dir,$(RAW_DIR))
	$(call ensure_dir,$(PROC_DIR))
	$(call ensure_dir,$(RESULTS_DIR))
	$(call ensure_dir,$(REPORT_DIR))
	$(call ensure_dir,$(LOG_DIR))
	$(call ensure_dir,$(TMP_DIR))
	$(call log_step,Initialized directories for $(PROJECT) in $(ENV))
	printf 'project=%s\nph=%s\ntemp_k=%s\n' '$(PROJECT)' '$(PH)' '$(TEMP_K)' > $(CFG_DIR)/runtime.env

validate: $(LOG_DIR)/inputs.valid ## Validate raw chemistry inputs

$(LOG_DIR)/inputs.valid: | init
	$(call log_step,Validating input files)
	count=0
	for f in $(SDF_INPUTS) $(CSV_INPUTS); do
		if [[ -n "$$f" && -e "$$f" ]]; then
			echo "validated $$f"
			count=$$((count+1))
		fi
	done
	if [[ $$count -eq 0 ]]; then
		echo "No raw input files detected; creating placeholder manifest"
		printf 'placeholder,true\n' > $(RAW_DIR)/manifest.csv
	fi
	printf 'ok\n' > $@

prepare: $(PDBS) ## Convert and standardize molecules for simulation

$(PROC_DIR)/%.pdb: $(RAW_DIR)/%.sdf | init
	$(call log_step,Converting $< to $@ at pH $(PH))
	if [[ ! -f "$<" ]]; then
		echo "Missing $<, generating placeholder SDF"
		printf '%s\n' '$*' > $<
	fi
	echo "$(OBABEL) $< -O $@ --gen3d -p $(PH)"
	printf 'HEADER %s\nATOM      1  C   MOL A   1       0.000   0.000   0.000\nEND\n' '$*' > $@

# Ensure demo raw inputs exist for pattern rules
$(RAW_DIR)/%.sdf: | init
	$(call log_step,Creating demo molecule source $@)
	printf '%s\n' '$* demo sdf' > $@

simulate: $(MINIMIZED) ## Run minimization on prepared structures

$(RESULTS_DIR)/%_minimized.pdb: $(PROC_DIR)/%.pdb | init
	$(call log_step,Minimizing $< with $(FORCEFIELD)/$(WATER_MODEL))
	echo "$(PACKMOL) < $(TMP_DIR)/$*.inp"
	cat > $(TMP_DIR)/$*.inp <<EOF
# packmol input for $*
tolerance 2.0
filetype pdb
output $(TMP_DIR)/$*_boxed.pdb
structure $<
  number 1
  inside box 0. 0. 0. $(BOX_SIZE) $(BOX_SIZE) $(BOX_SIZE)
end structure
EOF
	echo "$(GROMACS) pdb2gmx -f $(TMP_DIR)/$*_boxed.pdb -o $@ -ff $(FORCEFIELD) -water $(WATER_MODEL)"
	cp $< $@
	echo "REMARK minimized at $(TEMP_K)K" >> $@

analyze: $(RESULTS_DIR)/energies.csv $(RESULTS_DIR)/descriptors.csv ## Analyze chemistry outputs

$(RESULTS_DIR)/energies.csv: $(MINIMIZED) | init
	$(call log_step,Calculating mock energies)
	printf 'molecule,energy_kcal_mol\n' > $@
	for f in $(MINIMIZED); do
		base=$$(basename "$$f" _minimized.pdb)
		printf '%s,%s\n' "$$base" "-7.$$((RANDOM % 10))" >> $@
	done

$(RESULTS_DIR)/descriptors.csv: $(PDBS) | init
	$(call log_step,Generating descriptors table)
	printf 'molecule,mw,logp,hbd,hba\n' > $@
	for m in $(MOLECULES); do
		printf '%s,%s,%s,%s,%s\n' "$$m" "180.0" "1.2" "1" "3" >> $@
	done

report: $(REPORTS) ## Build chemistry summary reports

$(REPORT_DIR)/summary.txt: $(RESULTS_DIR)/energies.csv $(RESULTS_DIR)/descriptors.csv | init
	$(call log_step,Writing summary report)
	{
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Environment: $(ENV)"
		echo "pH: $(PH)"
		echo "Temperature: $(TEMP_K) K"
		printf '\nEnergies:\n'
		cat $(RESULTS_DIR)/energies.csv
		printf '\nDescriptors:\n'
		cat $(RESULTS_DIR)/descriptors.csv
	} > $@

$(REPORT_DIR)/qc.txt: $(PDBS) $(MINIMIZED) | init
	$(call log_step,Running QC checks)
	missing=0
	{
		echo "QC Report"
		for f in $(PDBS) $(MINIMIZED); do
			if [[ -s "$$f" ]]; then
				echo "PASS $$f"
			else
				echo "FAIL $$f"
				missing=$$((missing+1))
			fi
		done
		echo "Missing count: $$missing"
	} > $@

qc: $(REPORT_DIR)/qc.txt ## Alias for QC checks
	@true

clean: ## Remove generated intermediate files
	$(call log_step,Cleaning intermediates)
	rm -rf $(PROC_DIR)/* $(TMP_DIR)/*
	rm -f $(LOG_DIR)/inputs.valid

 distclean: clean ## Remove all generated artifacts except raw data
	$(call log_step,Performing full cleanup)
	rm -rf $(RESULTS_DIR)/* $(REPORT_DIR)/* $(LOG_DIR)/*

# Convenience target for notebooks or ad hoc summaries
preview: $(REPORT_DIR)/summary.txt ## Print summary to console
	cat $<

# Safety check example
check-env: ## Validate selected environment values
	case "$(ENV)" in \
		dev|test|prod) echo "ENV=$(ENV) ok" ;; \
		*) echo "Unsupported ENV=$(ENV)"; exit 1 ;; \
	esac
	case "$(PH)" in \
		'' ) echo "PH must not be empty"; exit 1 ;; \
		* ) echo "PH=$(PH)" ;; \
	esac

# Document chemistry assumptions
assumptions: ## Print workflow assumptions
	@echo "Assumes small molecules are protonated near pH $(PH)"
	@echo "Assumes cubic solvation box of $(BOX_SIZE) nm"
	@echo "Assumes forcefield $(FORCEFIELD) with water $(WATER_MODEL)"

# Example 2: Analytical chemistry Makefile for spectroscopy workflow # Best practices: # - Reproducible variables # - Separated raw/derived/report outputs # - Phony orchestration targets # - Auditable logs and manifests SHELL := /bin/bash .SHELLFLAGS := -eu -o pipefail -c .ONESHELL: .DELETE_ON_ERROR: .DEFAULT_GOAL := help LAB := spectroscopy-qc RUN_ID ?= run-001 OPERATOR ?= chemist DATE := $(shell date +%F) RAW := raw DERIVED := derived FIG := figures REPORT := report LOG := log CONF := conf BIN := bin PYTHON ?= python3 GNUPLOT ?= gnuplot PANDOC ?= pandoc WAVELENGTH_MIN ?= 200 WAVELENGTH_MAX ?= 800 SMOOTH_WINDOW ?= 7 BASELINE_METHOD ?= rolling-ball SPECTRA := sample_a sample_b sample_c blank standard_mix reference RAW_CSV := $(addprefix $(RAW)/,$(addsuffix .csv,$(SPECTRA))) NORM_CSV := $(addprefix $(DERIVED)/,$(addsuffix _norm.csv,$(SPECTRA))) PEAKS := $(addprefix $(DERIVED)/,$(addsuffix _peaks.csv,$(SPECTRA))) PLOTS := $(addprefix $(FIG)/,$(addsuffix .png,$(SPECTRA))) .PHONY: help all init ingest preprocess detect-peaks plot report audit clean distclean help: ## Print available targets @awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*## "}; /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-18s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) all: init ingest preprocess detect-peaks plot report audit ## Full spectroscopy workflow init: ## Create directory structure and runtime config mkdir -p $(RAW) $(DERIVED) $(FIG) $(REPORT) $(LOG) $(CONF) $(BIN) printf 'lab=%s\nrun_id=%s\noperator=%s\n' '$(LAB)' '$(RUN_ID)' '$(OPERATOR)' > $(CONF)/runtime.env echo "[$(DATE)] initialized $(LAB) $(RUN_ID)" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log template-tools: | init ## Install demo helper scripts cat > $(BIN)/normalize.py <<'PY' print('demo normalizer') PY chmod +x $(BIN)/normalize.py cat > $(BIN)/find_peaks.py <<'PY' print('demo peaks') PY chmod +x $(BIN)/find_peaks.py ingest: $(RAW_CSV) $(RAW)/manifest.tsv ## Stage spectroscopy data $(RAW)/%.csv: | init echo "wavelength_nm,absorbance" > $@ for wl in $$(seq $(WAVELENGTH_MIN) 50 $(WAVELENGTH_MAX)); do printf '%s,0.%s\n' "$$wl" "$$(( (wl / 50) % 9 ))" >> $@ done echo "[$(DATE)] created demo spectrum $@" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log $(RAW)/manifest.tsv: $(RAW_CSV) | init printf 'file\tbytes\n' > $@ for f in $(RAW_CSV); do printf '%s\t%s\n' "$$f" "$$(wc -c < $$f)" >> $@ done preprocess: $(NORM_CSV) $(DERIVED)/baseline-summary.csv ## Normalize spectra and summarize preprocessing $(DERIVED)/%_norm.csv: $(RAW)/%.csv | init template-tools { head -n 1 $< tail -n +2 $< | awk -F, 'BEGIN{OFS=","} {print $$1, $$2}' } > $@ echo "processed=$< method=$(BASELINE_METHOD) smooth=$(SMOOTH_WINDOW)" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log $(DERIVED)/baseline-summary.csv: $(NORM_CSV) | init printf 'sample,baseline_method,smooth_window\n' > $@ for s in $(SPECTRA); do printf '%s,%s,%s\n' "$$s" "$(BASELINE_METHOD)" "$(SMOOTH_WINDOW)" >> $@ done detect-peaks: $(PEAKS) ## Detect spectral peaks $(DERIVED)/%_peaks.csv: $(DERIVED)/%_norm.csv | init template-tools printf 'peak_nm,intensity\n' > $@ awk -F, 'NR>1 && $$1 % 100 == 0 {print $$1 "," $$2}' $< >> $@ echo "peak-detect $< -> $@" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log plot: $(PLOTS) $(FIG)/overlay.png ## Generate figures for chemistry review $(FIG)/%.png: $(DERIVED)/%_norm.csv | init printf 'PNG placeholder for %s\n' '$*' > $@ echo "plot $<" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log $(FIG)/overlay.png: $(NORM_CSV) | init printf 'Overlay figure for %s\n' '$(RUN_ID)' > $@ for f in $(NORM_CSV); do echo "include $$f" >> $@; done report: $(REPORT)/summary.md $(REPORT)/summary.html ## Build analytical chemistry report $(REPORT)/summary.md: $(RAW)/manifest.tsv $(DERIVED)/baseline-summary.csv $(PEAKS) | init { echo "# Spectroscopy QC" echo echo "- Lab: $(LAB)" echo "- Run: $(RUN_ID)" echo "- Operator: $(OPERATOR)" echo "- Wavelength range: $(WAVELENGTH_MIN)-$(WAVELENGTH_MAX) nm" echo echo "## Files" cat $(RAW)/manifest.tsv echo echo "## Baseline" cat $(DERIVED)/baseline-summary.csv echo echo "## Peak Files" for f in $(PEAKS); do echo "- $$f"; done } > $@ $(REPORT)/summary.html: $(REPORT)/summary.md | init { echo "
"

" } > $@ audit: $(REPORT)/audit.txt ## Validate chemistry workflow outputs $(REPORT)/audit.txt: $(RAW_CSV) $(NORM_CSV) $(PEAKS) $(PLOTS) | init fails=0 { echo "Audit for $(RUN_ID)" for f in $(RAW_CSV) $(NORM_CSV) $(PEAKS) $(PLOTS); do if [[ -s $$f ]]; then echo "OK $$f" else echo "MISSING $$f" fails=$$((fails+1)) fi done echo "failures=$$fails" } > $@ print-config: ## Show selected processing parameters @echo "LAB=$(LAB)" @echo "RUN_ID=$(RUN_ID)" @echo "BASELINE_METHOD=$(BASELINE_METHOD)" @echo "SMOOTH_WINDOW=$(SMOOTH_WINDOW)" @echo "RANGE=$(WAVELENGTH_MIN)-$(WAVELENGTH_MAX)" clean: ## Remove derived chemistry data rm -rf $(DERIVED)/* $(FIG)/* echo "[$(DATE)] cleaned derived artifacts" >> $(LOG)/pipeline.log distclean: clean ## Remove all generated artifacts rm -rf $(REPORT)/* $(LOG)/* $(CONF)/runtime.env $(RAW)/manifest.tsv for f in $(RAW_CSV); do rm -f $$f; done reprocess: clean preprocess detect-peaks plot report audit ## Rebuild from staged raw data @true check-operator: ## Ensure operator name is set @if [[ -z "$(OPERATOR)" ]]; then echo "OPERATOR required"; exit 1; fi @echo "operator=$(OPERATOR)" show-samples: ## List current chemistry samples @for s in $(SPECTRA); do echo $$s; done status: ## Print summary of generated outputs @echo "raw: $(words $(RAW_CSV)) files" @echo "norm: $(words $(NORM_CSV)) files" @echo "peaks: $(words $(PEAKS)) files" @echo "plots: $(words $(PLOTS)) files" @echo "reports: $(REPORT)/summary.md $(REPORT)/summary.html $(REPORT)/audit.txt"

.PHONY: help all init inventory plan safety execute summarize qc clean distclean

help: ## Show help for synthesis workflow
	@awk 'BEGIN{FS=":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-16s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

all: init inventory plan safety execute summarize qc ## Full synthetic chemistry runbook

init: ## Create folders and runtime metadata
	mkdir -p $(DIR_RAW) $(DIR_PLAN) $(DIR_BATCH) $(DIR_SAFETY) $(DIR_RESULTS) $(DIR_REPORTS) $(DIR_LOG) $(DIR_TMP)
	printf 'project=%s\nbatch=%s\nchemist=%s\ndate=%s\n' '$(PROJECT)' '$(BATCH)' '$(CHEMIST)' '$(DATE)' > $(DIR_LOG)/run.env
	echo "init $(PROJECT) $(BATCH)" >> $(DIR_LOG)/events.log

inventory: $(DIR_RAW)/inventory.csv $(DIR_RAW)/reagents.csv ## Prepare reagent inventory manifests

$(DIR_RAW)/inventory.csv: | init
	printf 'item,lot,available_g\n' > $@
	printf 'aryl_bromide,LOT001,25.0\n' >> $@
	printf 'boronic_acid,LOT002,18.0\n' >> $@
	printf '$(BASE),LOT003,100.0\n' >> $@
	printf '$(CATALYST),LOT004,5.0\n' >> $@
	printf '$(SOLVENT),LOT005,1000.0\n' >> $@

$(DIR_RAW)/reagents.csv: | init
	printf 'name,equiv,role\n' > $@
	printf 'aryl_bromide,1.0,electrophile\n' >> $@
	printf 'boronic_acid,1.2,nucleophile\n' >> $@
	printf '$(BASE),2.0,base\n' >> $@
	printf '$(CATALYST),0.03,catalyst\n' >> $@
	printf '$(SOLVENT),q.s.,solvent\n' >> $@

plan: $(PLANS) $(DIR_PLAN)/master-plan.tsv ## Generate reaction plans

$(DIR_PLAN)/%.yaml: $(DIR_RAW)/reagents.csv | init
	cat > $@ <<EOF
reaction: $*
project: $(PROJECT)
batch: $(BATCH)
solvent: $(SOLVENT)
base: $(BASE)
catalyst: $(CATALYST)
temperature_c: $(TEMP_C)
time_h: $(TIME_H)
atmosphere: $(ATMOSPHERE)
chemist: $(CHEMIST)
EOF
	echo "planned $*" >> $(DIR_LOG)/events.log

$(DIR_PLAN)/master-plan.tsv: $(PLANS) | init
	printf 'reaction\tsolvent\tbase\tcatalyst\ttemp_c\ttime_h\n' > $@
	for r in $(REACTIONS); do
		printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$$r" "$(SOLVENT)" "$(BASE)" "$(CATALYST)" "$(TEMP_C)" "$(TIME_H)" >> $@
	done

safety: $(SAFETY_DOCS) $(DIR_SAFETY)/waste.md ## Write safety and waste handling guidance

$(DIR_SAFETY)/hazards.md: | init
	{
		echo "# Hazards"
		echo "- Solvent: $(SOLVENT) may be flammable."
		echo "- Base: $(BASE) may be irritant or corrosive."
		echo "- Catalyst: $(CATALYST) handle with gloves and in hood."
		echo "- Reaction at $(TEMP_C) C under $(ATMOSPHERE)."
	} > $@

$(DIR_SAFETY)/ppe.md: | init
	{
		echo "# PPE"
		echo "- Lab coat"
		echo "- Splash goggles"
		echo "- Nitrile gloves"
		echo "- Use fume hood for charging and sampling"
	} > $@

$(DIR_SAFETY)/waste.md: | init
	{
		echo "# Waste"
		echo "- Segregate halogenated/non-halogenated solvent waste"
		echo "- Collect Pd-containing solids for hazardous disposal"
		echo "- Label aqueous basic waste before neutralization"
	} > $@

execute: $(BATCH_SHEETS) $(RESULT_TABLES) ## Produce batch sheets and mock reaction outcomes

$(DIR_BATCH)/%.md: $(DIR_PLAN)/%.yaml $(DIR_SAFETY)/ppe.md | init
	{
		echo "# Batch Sheet: $*"
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Batch: $(BATCH)"
		echo "Conditions: $(SOLVENT), $(BASE), $(CATALYST), $(TEMP_C) C, $(TIME_H) h"
		echo "Atmosphere: $(ATMOSPHERE)"
		echo "Checklist: charge, degas, heat, sample, quench, workup"
	} > $@

$(DIR_RESULTS)/%.csv: $(DIR_BATCH)/%.md | init
	printf 'reaction,conversion_pct,yield_pct,selectivity_pct\n' > $@
	printf '%s,%s,%s,%s\n' '$*' "$$((70 + RANDOM % 25))" "$$((50 + RANDOM % 35))" "$$((80 + RANDOM % 15))" >> $@
	echo "executed $*" >> $(DIR_LOG)/events.log

summarize: $(DIR_REPORTS)/summary.md $(DIR_REPORTS)/results.tsv ## Summarize campaign outcomes

$(DIR_REPORTS)/results.tsv: $(RESULT_TABLES) | init
	printf 'reaction\tconversion_pct\tyield_pct\tselectivity_pct\n' > $@
	for f in $(RESULT_TABLES); do
		tail -n +2 $$f | tr ',' '\t' >> $@
	done

$(DIR_REPORTS)/summary.md: $(DIR_REPORTS)/results.tsv $(DIR_PLAN)/master-plan.tsv | init
	{
		echo "# Synthetic Campaign Summary"
		echo
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Batch: $(BATCH)"
		echo "Chemist: $(CHEMIST)"
		echo
		echo "## Conditions"
		cat $(DIR_PLAN)/master-plan.tsv
		echo
		echo "## Results"
		cat $(DIR_REPORTS)/results.tsv
	} > $@

qc: $(DIR_REPORTS)/qc.txt ## Verify required synthesis records exist

$(DIR_REPORTS)/qc.txt: $(PLANS) $(BATCH_SHEETS) $(RESULT_TABLES) $(SAFETY_DOCS) | init
	errors=0
	{
		echo "QC for $(PROJECT) $(BATCH)"
		for f in $(PLANS) $(BATCH_SHEETS) $(RESULT_TABLES) $(SAFETY_DOCS); do
			if [[ -s $$f ]]; then
				echo "OK $$f"
			else
				echo "ERROR $$f"
				errors=$$((errors+1))
			fi
		done
		echo "errors=$$errors"
	} > $@

conditions: ## Print current chemistry conditions
	@echo "SOLVENT=$(SOLVENT)"
	@echo "BASE=$(BASE)"
	@echo "CATALYST=$(CATALYST)"
	@echo "TEMP_C=$(TEMP_C)"
	@echo "TIME_H=$(TIME_H)"
	@echo "ATMOSPHERE=$(ATMOSPHERE)"

clean: ## Remove generated plans, results, and reports
	rm -rf $(DIR_PLAN)/* $(DIR_BATCH)/* $(DIR_RESULTS)/* $(DIR_REPORTS)/* $(DIR_TMP)/*

events: ## Show event log
	@cat $(DIR_LOG)/events.log

distclean: clean ## Remove all generated chemistry records except Makefile
	rm -rf $(DIR_SAFETY)/* $(DIR_LOG)/* $(DIR_RAW)/*

# Example 4: Environmental chemistry assay Makefile
# Focused on sample registration, calibration, QA/QC, and reporting.

SHELL := /bin/bash
.SHELLFLAGS := -eu -o pipefail -c
.ONESHELL:
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

PROJECT := nitrate-monitoring
SITE ?= river-west
METHOD ?= ion-chromatography
ANALYST ?= team-a
DATE := $(shell date +%F)

RAW_DIR := samples
CAL_DIR := calibration
DER_DIR := derived
QC_DIR := qc
REP_DIR := reports
LOG_DIR := log

STD_LEVELS := 0.1 0.5 1.0 5.0 10.0
SAMPLES := inflow outflow upstream downstream field_blank duplicate_01
SAMPLE_FILES := $(addprefix $(RAW_DIR)/,$(addsuffix .csv,$(SAMPLES)))
CAL_FILES := $(addprefix $(CAL_DIR)/std_,$(addsuffix .csv,$(STD_LEVELS)))
PROCESSED := $(addprefix $(DER_DIR)/,$(addsuffix _processed.csv,$(SAMPLES)))

.PHONY: help all init register calibrate process qc report clean distclean archive

help: ## Display workflow targets
	@awk 'BEGIN{FS=":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-14s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

all: init register calibrate process qc report ## Complete environmental chemistry pipeline

init: ## Create directories and metadata
	mkdir -p $(RAW_DIR) $(CAL_DIR) $(DER_DIR) $(QC_DIR) $(REP_DIR) $(LOG_DIR)
	printf 'project=%s\nsite=%s\nmethod=%s\nanalyst=%s\n' '$(PROJECT)' '$(SITE)' '$(METHOD)' '$(ANALYST)' > $(LOG_DIR)/meta.env
	echo "$(DATE) init $(PROJECT) $(SITE)" >> $(LOG_DIR)/history.log

register: $(SAMPLE_FILES) $(RAW_DIR)/chain_of_custody.tsv ## Register field samples

$(RAW_DIR)/%.csv: | init
	printf 'time_min,signal\n' > $@
	for t in 0 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s,%s\n' "$$t" "$$((10 + RANDOM % 90))" >> $@; done

$(RAW_DIR)/chain_of_custody.tsv: $(SAMPLE_FILES) | init
	printf 'sample\tsite\tcollector\tstatus\n' > $@
	for s in $(SAMPLES); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$$s" "$(SITE)" "field-team" "received" >> $@; done

calibrate: $(CAL_FILES) $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv ## Generate calibration standards and curve

$(CAL_DIR)/std_%.csv: | init
	printf 'level_mg_L,response\n' > $@
	printf '%s,%s\n' '$*' "$$((100 + RANDOM % 50))" >> $@

$(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv: $(CAL_FILES) | init
	printf 'slope,intercept,r_squared\n' > $@
	printf '12.3,0.4,0.998\n' >> $@
	echo "calibration prepared" >> $(LOG_DIR)/history.log

process: $(PROCESSED) $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv ## Convert signals to concentrations

$(DER_DIR)/%_processed.csv: $(RAW_DIR)/%.csv $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv | init
	printf 'time_min,signal,estimated_mg_L\n' > $@
	awk -F, 'NR>1 {printf "%s,%s,%.2f\n", $$1, $$2, ($$2-0.4)/12.3}' $< >> $@

$(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv: $(PROCESSED) | init
	printf 'sample,mean_mg_L\n' > $@
	for f in $(PROCESSED); do
		name=$$(basename $$f _processed.csv)
		mean=$$(awk -F, 'NR>1 {sum+=$$3; n++} END {if(n) printf "%.2f", sum/n; else print "0.00"}' $$f)
		printf '%s,%s\n' "$$name" "$$mean" >> $@
	done

qc: $(QC_DIR)/qa_summary.txt $(QC_DIR)/acceptance.tsv ## Perform QA/QC checks

$(QC_DIR)/qa_summary.txt: $(RAW_DIR)/chain_of_custody.tsv $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv | init
	{
		echo "QA Summary"
		echo "Method: $(METHOD)"
		echo "Site: $(SITE)"
		echo "Calibration:"
		cat $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv
		echo "Samples:"
		cat $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv
	} > $@

$(QC_DIR)/acceptance.tsv: $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv | init
	printf 'sample\tstatus\n' > $@
	awk -F, 'NR>1 {status=($$2+0 < 8.0)?"PASS":"REVIEW"; printf "%s\t%s\n", $$1, status}' $< >> $@

report: $(REP_DIR)/nitrate_report.md $(REP_DIR)/nitrate_report.txt ## Build environmental chemistry report

$(REP_DIR)/nitrate_report.md: $(RAW_DIR)/chain_of_custody.tsv $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv $(QC_DIR)/acceptance.tsv | init
	{
		echo "# Environmental Chemistry Report"
		echo
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Site: $(SITE)"
		echo "Method: $(METHOD)"
		echo
		echo "## Chain of Custody"
		cat $(RAW_DIR)/chain_of_custody.tsv
		echo
		echo "## Calibration"
		cat $(CAL_DIR)/curve.csv
		echo
		echo "## Concentrations"
		cat $(DER_DIR)/concentrations.csv
		echo
		echo "## Acceptance"
		cat $(QC_DIR)/acceptance.tsv
	} > $@

$(REP_DIR)/nitrate_report.txt: $(REP_DIR)/nitrate_report.md | init
	cp $< $@

archive: $(REP_DIR)/archive.lst ## Create archive manifest

$(REP_DIR)/archive.lst: $(SAMPLE_FILES) $(CAL_FILES) $(PROCESSED) | init
	for f in $^; do echo $$f; done > $@

method-check: ## Validate method name selection
	@if [[ "$(METHOD)" != "ion-chromatography" && "$(METHOD)" != "colorimetry" ]]; then \
		echo "Unsupported METHOD=$(METHOD)"; exit 1; \
	fi
	@echo "METHOD=$(METHOD) accepted"

show-site: ## Print selected sampling site
	@echo "SITE=$(SITE)"

clean: ## Remove processed chemistry outputs
	rm -rf $(DER_DIR)/* $(QC_DIR)/* $(REP_DIR)/*

evidence: ## Show metadata and history
	@cat $(LOG_DIR)/meta.env
	@cat $(LOG_DIR)/history.log

distclean: clean ## Remove all generated sample and calibration files
	rm -rf $(RAW_DIR)/* $(CAL_DIR)/* $(LOG_DIR)/*

# Example 5: Physical chemistry kinetics Makefile
# Demonstrates experiment matrices, fitting, diagnostics, and report generation.

SHELL := /bin/bash
.SHELLFLAGS := -eu -o pipefail -c
.ONESHELL:
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

PROJECT := ester-hydrolysis-kinetics
MODEL ?= first-order
TEMPS := 288 298 308 318
REPS := 1 2 3
RAW := raw
FIT := fit
PLOT := plot
DOC := doc
LOG := log
TMP := tmp

SERIES := $(foreach T,$(TEMPS),$(foreach R,$(REPS),T$(T)_R$(R)))
RAW_FILES := $(addprefix $(RAW)/,$(addsuffix .csv,$(SERIES)))
FIT_FILES := $(addprefix $(FIT)/,$(addsuffix .json,$(SERIES)))
DIAG_FILES := $(addprefix $(FIT)/,$(addsuffix _diag.txt,$(SERIES)))

.PHONY: help all init acquire fit summarize arrhenius report clean distclean status

help: ## Show kinetics targets
	@awk 'BEGIN{FS=":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-12s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

all: init acquire fit summarize arrhenius report status ## Run kinetics workflow

init: ## Create folders and log selection
	mkdir -p $(RAW) $(FIT) $(PLOT) $(DOC) $(LOG) $(TMP)
	printf 'project=%s\nmodel=%s\n' '$(PROJECT)' '$(MODEL)' > $(LOG)/settings.env
	echo "init $(PROJECT) model=$(MODEL)" >> $(LOG)/run.log

acquire: $(RAW_FILES) $(RAW)/manifest.tsv ## Create mock time-course measurements

$(RAW)/T%_R%.csv: | init
	printf 'time_s,concentration_mM\n' > $@
	for t in 0 60 120 180 240 300 360; do
		printf '%s,%.3f\n' "$$t" "$$(awk 'BEGIN{srand(); printf 10*exp(-0.003*'$$t') + 0.1}')" >> $@
	done

$(RAW)/manifest.tsv: $(RAW_FILES) | init
	printf 'file\ttemp_k\treplicate\n' > $@
	for s in $(SERIES); do
		t=$${s#T}; t=$${t%_R*}; r=$${s##*_R}
		printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(RAW)/$$s.csv" "$$t" "$$r" >> $@
	done

fit: $(FIT_FILES) $(DIAG_FILES) ## Fit kinetic traces

$(FIT)/T%_R%.json: $(RAW)/T%_R%.csv | init
	k="0.003$*"
	cat > $@ <<EOF
{
  "series": "T$*_R$*",
  "model": "$(MODEL)",
  "k_obs": 0.0031,
  "r_squared": 0.995,
  "units": "s^-1"
}
EOF
	echo "fit $<" >> $(LOG)/run.log

$(FIT)/T%_R%_diag.txt: $(FIT)/T%_R%.json | init
	{
		echo "Diagnostics for $<"
		echo "Residual pattern: acceptable"
		echo "AIC: 12.3"
		echo "Convergence: yes"
	} > $@

summarize: $(FIT)/summary.csv ## Summarize fitted rate constants across conditions

$(FIT)/summary.csv: $(FIT_FILES) | init
	printf 'series,temp_k,replicate,k_obs,r_squared\n' > $@
	for s in $(SERIES); do
		t=$${s#T}; t=$${t%_R*}; r=$${s##*_R}
		printf '%s,%s,%s,0.0031,0.995\n' "$$s" "$$t" "$$r" >> $@
	done

arrhenius: $(FIT)/arrhenius.csv $(PLOT)/arrhenius.png ## Compute Arrhenius summary

$(FIT)/arrhenius.csv: $(FIT)/summary.csv | init
	printf 'temp_k,ln_k,inv_temp\n' > $@
	for t in $(TEMPS); do
		printf '%s,%.4f,%.6f\n' "$$t" "-5.77" "$$(awk 'BEGIN{printf 1/'$$t'}')" >> $@
	done

$(PLOT)/arrhenius.png: $(FIT)/arrhenius.csv | init
	printf 'Arrhenius plot placeholder\n' > $@
	cat $< >> $@

report: $(DOC)/report.md $(DOC)/report.txt $(DOC)/qc.txt ## Assemble physical chemistry report

$(DOC)/report.md: $(RAW)/manifest.tsv $(FIT)/summary.csv $(FIT)/arrhenius.csv | init
	{
		echo "# Kinetics Report"
		echo
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Model: $(MODEL)"
		echo
		echo "## Series"
		cat $(RAW)/manifest.tsv
		echo
		echo "## Fit Summary"
		cat $(FIT)/summary.csv
		echo
		echo "## Arrhenius"
		cat $(FIT)/arrhenius.csv
	} > $@

$(DOC)/report.txt: $(DOC)/report.md | init
	cp $< $@

$(DOC)/qc.txt: $(FIT_FILES) $(DIAG_FILES) $(PLOT)/arrhenius.png | init
	{
		echo "QC"
		for f in $(FIT_FILES) $(DIAG_FILES) $(PLOT)/arrhenius.png; do
			if [[ -s $$f ]]; then echo "OK $$f"; else echo "FAIL $$f"; fi
		done
	} > $@

status: ## Print project status counts
	@echo "series=$(words $(SERIES))"
	@echo "raw=$(words $(RAW_FILES))"
	@echo "fits=$(words $(FIT_FILES))"
	@echo "diagnostics=$(words $(DIAG_FILES))"

model-check: ## Validate kinetic model choice
	@if [[ "$(MODEL)" != "first-order" && "$(MODEL)" != "second-order" ]]; then \
		echo "Unsupported MODEL=$(MODEL)"; exit 1; \
	fi
	@echo "MODEL=$(MODEL) accepted"

clean: ## Remove fit, plots, docs, temp
	rm -rf $(FIT)/* $(PLOT)/* $(DOC)/* $(TMP)/*

distclean: clean ## Remove all generated kinetics data
	rm -rf $(RAW)/* $(LOG)/*

peek: $(FIT)/summary.csv ## Print fit summary
	@cat $<

		echo '$$$$'

assay: $(ASSAY_FILES) $(ASSAY_DIR)/plate-map.tsv ## Create mock assay readouts

	printf 'concentration_nM,response_pct\n' > $@

	printf 'well\tcompound\n' > $@

	printf 'compound,ic50_nM,pIC50\n' > $@

$(ANALYSIS_DIR)/sar-table.csv: $(RAW_DIR)/registry.csv $(LIB_DIR)/physchem.csv $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/potency.csv | init
	printf 'compound,series,mw,clogp,tpsa,ic50_nM,pIC50\n' > $@
	for c in $(COMPOUNDS); do printf '%s,core-a,250.0,2.0,45.0,%s,6.5\n' "$$c" "$$((20 + RANDOM % 900))" >> $@; done

report: $(REP_DIR)/sar.md $(REP_DIR)/sar.txt $(REP_DIR)/qc.txt ## Build medicinal chemistry report

$(REP_DIR)/sar.md: $(RAW_DIR)/registry.csv $(LIB_DIR)/physchem.csv $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/potency.csv $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/sar-table.csv | init

		echo "## Registry"
		cat $(RAW_DIR)/registry.csv
		echo
		echo "## Properties"
		cat $(LIB_DIR)/physchem.csv
		echo
		echo "## Potency"
		cat $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/potency.csv

$(REP_DIR)/sar.txt: $(REP_DIR)/sar.md | init
	cp $< $@

$(REP_DIR)/qc.txt: $(SMI_FILES) $(SDF_FILES) $(ASSAY_FILES) | init
	{
		echo "QC $(PROGRAM) $(ROUND)"
		for f in $(SMI_FILES) $(SDF_FILES) $(ASSAY_FILES); do
			if [[ -s $$f ]]; then echo "OK $$f"; else echo "FAIL $$f"; fi
		done

dashboard: $(REP_DIR)/dashboard.tsv ## Create compact dashboard for project tracking

$(REP_DIR)/dashboard.tsv: $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/potency.csv | init
	printf 'compound\tstatus\n' > $@
	awk -F, 'NR>1 {status=($$2+0<200)?"advance":"hold"; printf "%s\t%s\n", $$1, status}' $< >> $@

show-target: ## Print selected target

assay-check: ## Validate assay type
	@if [[ "$(ASSAY)" != "biochemical" && "$(ASSAY)" != "cellular" ]]; then \
		echo "Unsupported ASSAY=$(ASSAY)"; exit 1; \
	fi

	rm -rf $(ASSAY_DIR)/* $(ANALYSIS_DIR)/* $(REP_DIR)/*

	rm -rf $(RAW_DIR)/* $(LIB_DIR)/* $(LOG_DIR)/*

# Example 7: Polymer chemistry Makefile

SHELL := /bin/bash
.SHELLFLAGS := -eu -o pipefail -c
.ONESHELL:
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

PROJECT := epoxy-formulation
BATCH ?= P-100
RESIN ?= bisphenol-a-epoxy
HARDENER ?= amine-x
CURING_TEMP_C ?= 120
CURING_TIME_MIN ?= 45

RAW := raw
FORM := formulations
TEST := tests
RES := results
REP := reports
LOG := log

FORMULAS := f01 f02 f03 f04 f05
FORM_FILES := $(addprefix $(FORM)/,$(addsuffix .csv,$(FORMULAS)))
TEST_FILES := $(addprefix $(TEST)/,$(addsuffix .csv,$(FORMULAS)))
RES_FILES := $(addprefix $(RES)/,$(addsuffix .tsv,$(FORMULAS)))

.PHONY: help all init formulate cure test summarize report clean distclean traceability

help: ## Display available polymer chemistry targets
	@awk 'BEGIN{FS=":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+:.*## / {printf "%-14s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

all: init formulate cure test summarize report traceability ## Complete polymer workflow

init: ## Initialize folders and project log
	mkdir -p $(RAW) $(FORM) $(TEST) $(RES) $(REP) $(LOG)
	printf 'project=%s\nbatch=%s\nresin=%s\nhardener=%s\n' '$(PROJECT)' '$(BATCH)' '$(RESIN)' '$(HARDENER)' > $(LOG)/run.env

formulate: $(RAW)/inventory.csv $(FORM_FILES) ## Define formulation matrix

$(RAW)/inventory.csv: | init
	printf 'component,available_g\n' > $@
	printf '$(RESIN),500\n' >> $@
	printf '$(HARDENER),300\n' >> $@
	printf 'silica,200\n' >> $@
	printf 'pigment,50\n' >> $@

$(FORM)/%.csv: | init
	printf 'component,wt_pct\n' > $@
	printf '$(RESIN),60\n' >> $@
	printf '$(HARDENER),35\n' >> $@
	printf 'silica,%s\n' "$$((RANDOM%6))" >> $@
	printf 'pigment,%s\n' "$$((RANDOM%3))" >> $@

cure: $(RAW)/curing.md ## Generate curing protocol

$(RAW)/curing.md: $(FORM_FILES) | init
	{
		echo "# Curing Protocol"
		echo "Batch: $(BATCH)"
		echo "Temperature: $(CURING_TEMP_C) C"
		echo "Time: $(CURING_TIME_MIN) min"
		echo "Resin/Hardener: $(RESIN) / $(HARDENER)"
	} > $@

test: $(TEST_FILES) $(RES_FILES) ## Create mock mechanical test outputs

$(TEST)/%.csv: $(FORM)/%.csv $(RAW)/curing.md | init
	printf 'test,measurement\n' > $@
	printf 'tensile_mpa,%s\n' "$$((40 + RANDOM % 30))" >> $@
	printf 'elongation_pct,%s\n' "$$((2 + RANDOM % 8))" >> $@
	printf 'tg_c,%s\n' "$$((70 + RANDOM % 40))" >> $@

$(RES)/%.tsv: $(TEST)/%.csv | init
	printf 'formula\ttensile_mpa\telongation_pct\ttg_c\n' > $@
	awk -F, 'NR==2 {t=$$2} NR==3 {e=$$2} NR==4 {g=$$2} END {printf "%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", FILENAME, t, e, g}' $< >> $@

summarize: $(RES)/summary.tsv ## Summarize polymer properties

$(RES)/summary.tsv: $(RES_FILES) | init
	printf 'formula\ttensile_mpa\telongation_pct\ttg_c\n' > $@
	for f in $(RES_FILES); do tail -n +2 $$f >> $@; done

report: $(REP)/report.md $(REP)/qc.txt ## Create final formulation report

$(REP)/report.md: $(RAW)/inventory.csv $(RAW)/curing.md $(RES)/summary.tsv | init
	{
		echo "# Polymer Chemistry Report"
		echo
		echo "Project: $(PROJECT)"
		echo "Batch: $(BATCH)"
		echo
		echo "## Inventory"
		cat $(RAW)/inventory.csv
		echo
		echo "## Curing"
		cat $(RAW)/curing.md
		echo
		echo "## Results"
		cat $(RES)/summary.tsv
	} > $@

$(REP)/qc.txt: $(FORM_FILES) $(TEST_FILES) $(RES_FILES) | init
	{
		echo "QC"
		for f in $(FORM_FILES) $(TEST_FILES) $(RES_FILES); do
			if [[ -s $$f ]]; then echo "OK $$f"; else echo "FAIL $$f"; fi
		done
	} > $@

traceability: $(REP)/traceability.tsv ## Link formulations to tests and results

$(REP)/traceability.tsv: $(FORM_FILES) $(TEST_FILES) $(RES_FILES) | init
	printf 'formula\tformulation\ttest\tresult\n' > $@
	for x in $(FORMULAS); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$$x" "$(FORM)/$$x.csv" "$(TEST)/$$x.csv" "$(RES)/$$x.tsv" >> $@; done

materials: ## Print current materials
	@echo "RESIN=$(RESIN)"
	@echo "HARDENER=$(HARDENER)"

clean: ## Remove test results and reports
	rm -rf $(TEST)/* $(RES)/* $(REP)/*

distclean: clean ## Remove all generated polymer artifacts
	rm -rf $(RAW)/* $(FORM)/* $(LOG)/*
