-- MarineSpeciesDatabase.sql
-- SQL script for creating and populating a marine species database
-- Includes tables for taxonomy, observations, environmental data, and research projects

-- Create database
CREATE DATABASE marine_species_db;
USE marine_species_db;

-- Enable strict mode
SET sql_mode = 'STRICT_TRANS_TABLES';

-- Create tables

-- Taxonomy hierarchy
CREATE TABLE taxonomy (
    taxon_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    kingdom VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    phylum VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    class VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    order_taxon VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    family VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    genus VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    species VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    common_name VARCHAR(100),
    authority VARCHAR(100),
    taxonomic_rank VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    parent_taxon_id INT,
    is_extinct BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    iucn_status VARCHAR(20),
    description TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT unique_taxon UNIQUE (kingdom, phylum, class, order_taxon, family, genus, species),
    CONSTRAINT fk_parent_taxon FOREIGN KEY (parent_taxon_id) REFERENCES taxonomy(taxon_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Species characteristics
CREATE TABLE species_characteristics (
    characteristic_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    taxon_id INT NOT NULL,
    max_size_cm DECIMAL(10,2),
    min_size_cm DECIMAL(10,2),
    average_size_cm DECIMAL(10,2),
    max_weight_kg DECIMAL(10,2),
    min_weight_kg DECIMAL(10,2),
    average_weight_kg DECIMAL(10,2),
    lifespan_years INT,
    reproductive_strategy VARCHAR(100),
    fecundity INT,
    habitat_type VARCHAR(100),
    depth_range_min_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    depth_range_max_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    temperature_range_min_c DECIMAL(5,2),
    temperature_range_max_c DECIMAL(5,2),
    salinity_range_min_psu DECIMAL(5,2),
    salinity_range_max_psu DECIMAL(5,2),
    oxygen_range_min_ml_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    oxygen_range_max_ml_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    diet VARCHAR(255),
    predators VARCHAR(255),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT fk_taxon_id FOREIGN KEY (taxon_id) REFERENCES taxonomy(taxon_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_depth_range CHECK (depth_range_min_m <= depth_range_max_m),
    CONSTRAINT chk_temp_range CHECK (temperature_range_min_c <= temperature_range_max_c),
    CONSTRAINT chk_salinity_range CHECK (salinity_range_min_psu <= salinity_range_max_psu),
    CONSTRAINT chk_oxygen_range CHECK (oxygen_range_min_ml_l <= oxygen_range_max_ml_l)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Research projects
CREATE TABLE research_projects (
    project_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE,
    funding_source VARCHAR(100),
    principal_investigator VARCHAR(100),
    institution VARCHAR(100),
    contact_email VARCHAR(100),
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Sampling stations
CREATE TABLE sampling_stations (
    station_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    station_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    latitude DECIMAL(10,6) NOT NULL,
    longitude DECIMAL(10,6) NOT NULL,
    depth_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    region VARCHAR(100),
    description TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT chk_latitude CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
    CONSTRAINT chk_longitude CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Observations
CREATE TABLE observations (
    observation_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INT NOT NULL,
    station_id INT NOT NULL,
    taxon_id INT,
    observation_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    latitude DECIMAL(10,6) NOT NULL,
    longitude DECIMAL(10,6) NOT NULL,
    depth_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    quantity INT,
    quantity_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK (quantity_type IN ('individuals', 'biomass_kg', 'density_per_m2', 'density_per_m3')),
    life_stage VARCHAR(20),
    behavior VARCHAR(100),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_id FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES research_projects(project_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_station_id FOREIGN KEY (station_id) REFERENCES sampling_stations(station_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_taxon_id FOREIGN KEY (taxon_id) REFERENCES taxonomy(taxon_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_observation_depth CHECK (depth_m >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Environmental data
CREATE TABLE environmental_data (
    env_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    observation_id INT NOT NULL,
    temperature_c DECIMAL(5,2),
    salinity_psu DECIMAL(5,2),
    oxygen_ml_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    ph DECIMAL(3,2),
    turbidity_ntu DECIMAL(5,2),
    chlorophyll_ug_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    nitrate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    phosphate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    silicate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    current_speed_m_s DECIMAL(5,2),
    current_direction_deg DECIMAL(5,1),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT fk_observation_id FOREIGN KEY (observation_id) REFERENCES observations(observation_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Sampling methods
CREATE TABLE sampling_methods (
    method_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    method_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    equipment_used VARCHAR(255),
    target_species VARCHAR(255),
    depth_range_min_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    depth_range_max_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Observation methods (link table)
CREATE TABLE observation_methods (
    observation_id INT NOT NULL,
    method_id INT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (observation_id, method_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_obs_id FOREIGN KEY (observation_id) REFERENCES observations(observation_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_method_id FOREIGN KEY (method_id) REFERENCES sampling_methods(method_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Media associated with observations
CREATE TABLE observation_media (
    media_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    observation_id INT NOT NULL,
    media_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (media_type IN ('image', 'video', 'audio', '3d_model')),
    file_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    file_size_bytes BIGINT,
    resolution VARCHAR(20),
    duration_seconds DECIMAL(10,2),
    description TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT fk_obs_media_id FOREIGN KEY (observation_id) REFERENCES observations(observation_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Create indexes for performance
CREATE INDEX idx_taxonomy_species ON taxonomy(species);
CREATE INDEX idx_taxonomy_genus ON taxonomy(genus);
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_taxon ON observations(taxon_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_project ON observations(project_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_station ON observations(station_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_date ON observations(observation_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_location ON observations(latitude, longitude);
CREATE INDEX idx_env_observation ON environmental_data(observation_id);

-- Create stored procedures

-- Procedure to add a new species
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE add_species(
    IN p_kingdom VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_phylum VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_class VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_order VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_family VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_genus VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_species VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_common_name VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_authority VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_taxonomic_rank VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_parent_taxon_id INT,
    IN p_is_extinct BOOLEAN,
    IN p_iucn_status VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_description TEXT
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_taxon_id INT;
    
    -- Insert into taxonomy table
    INSERT INTO taxonomy (
        kingdom, phylum, class, order_taxon, family, genus, species, 
        common_name, authority, taxonomic_rank, parent_taxon_id, 
        is_extinct, iucn_status, description
    ) VALUES (
        p_kingdom, p_phylum, p_class, p_order, p_family, p_genus, p_species,
        p_common_name, p_authority, p_taxonomic_rank, p_parent_taxon_id,
        p_is_extinct, p_iucn_status, p_description
    );
    
    SET v_taxon_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();
    
    -- Return the new taxon_id
    SELECT v_taxon_id AS new_taxon_id;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Procedure to add an observation with environmental data
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE add_observation_with_env(
    IN p_project_id INT,
    IN p_station_id INT,
    IN p_taxon_id INT,
    IN p_observation_date TIMESTAMP,
    IN p_latitude DECIMAL(10,6),
    IN p_longitude DECIMAL(10,6),
    IN p_depth_m DECIMAL(10,2),
    IN p_quantity INT,
    IN p_quantity_type VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_life_stage VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_behavior VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_notes TEXT,
    IN p_temperature_c DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_salinity_psu DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_oxygen_ml_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_ph DECIMAL(3,2),
    IN p_turbidity_ntu DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_chlorophyll_ug_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_nitrate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_phosphate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_silicate_umol_l DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_current_speed_m_s DECIMAL(5,2),
    IN p_current_direction_deg DECIMAL(5,1)
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_observation_id INT;
    
    -- Insert observation
    INSERT INTO observations (
        project_id, station_id, taxon_id, observation_date, 
        latitude, longitude, depth_m, quantity, quantity_type, 
        life_stage, behavior, notes
    ) VALUES (
        p_project_id, p_station_id, p_taxon_id, p_observation_date,
        p_latitude, p_longitude, p_depth_m, p_quantity, p_quantity_type,
        p_life_stage, p_behavior, p_notes
    );
    
    SET v_observation_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();
    
    -- Insert environmental data
    INSERT INTO environmental_data (
        observation_id, temperature_c, salinity_psu, oxygen_ml_l, ph,
        turbidity_ntu, chlorophyll_ug_l, nitrate_umol_l, phosphate_umol_l,
        silicate_umol_l, current_speed_m_s, current_direction_deg
    ) VALUES (
        v_observation_id, p_temperature_c, p_salinity_psu, p_oxygen_ml_l, p_ph,
        p_turbidity_ntu, p_chlorophyll_ug_l, p_nitrate_umol_l, p_phosphate_umol_l,
        p_silicate_umol_l, p_current_speed_m_s, p_current_direction_deg
    );
    
    -- Return the new observation_id
    SELECT v_observation_id AS new_observation_id;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Procedure to get species distribution
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE get_species_distribution(
    IN p_taxon_id INT,
    IN p_start_date DATE,
    IN p_end_date DATE,
    IN p_min_depth DECIMAL(10,2),
    IN p_max_depth DECIMAL(10,2),
    IN p_min_latitude DECIMAL(10,6),
    IN p_max_latitude DECIMAL(10,6),
    IN p_min_longitude DECIMAL(10,6),
    IN p_max_longitude DECIMAL(10,6)
)
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        o.observation_id,
        o.observation_date,
        o.latitude,
        o.longitude,
        o.depth_m,
        o.quantity,
        o.quantity_type,
        o.life_stage,
        o.behavior,
        s.station_name,
        r.project_name,
        e.temperature_c,
        e.salinity_psu,
        e.oxygen_ml_l
    FROM observations o
    JOIN sampling_stations s ON o.station_id = s.station_id
    JOIN research_projects r ON o.project_id = r.project_id
    LEFT JOIN environmental_data e ON o.observation_id = e.observation_id
    WHERE o.taxon_id = p_taxon_id
    AND o.observation_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
    AND o.depth_m BETWEEN p_min_depth AND p_max_depth
    AND o.latitude BETWEEN p_min_latitude AND p_max_latitude
    AND o.longitude BETWEEN p_min_longitude AND p_max_longitude
    ORDER BY o.observation_date;
END //
DELIMITER ;

SELECT

    t.common_name,
    t.iucn_status,
    COUNT(o.observation_id) AS observation_count,
    MIN(o.depth_m) AS min_depth_m,
    MAX(o.depth_m) AS max_depth_m,
    MIN(o.latitude) AS min_latitude,
    MAX(o.latitude) AS max_latitude,
    MIN(o.longitude) AS min_longitude,
    MAX(o.longitude) AS max_longitude,
    AVG(e.temperature_c) AS avg_temperature_c,
    AVG(e.salinity_psu) AS avg_salinity_psu
FROM taxonomy t
LEFT JOIN observations o ON t.taxon_id = o.taxon_id
LEFT JOIN environmental_data e ON o.observation_id = e.observation_id
GROUP BY t.taxon_id, t.species, t.common_name, t.iucn_status;

    COUNT(DISTINCT o.taxon_id) AS species_count,
    COUNT(o.observation_id) AS observation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.station_id) AS station_count,
    MIN(o.observation_date) AS first_observation,
    MAX(o.observation_date) AS last_observation
FROM research_projects p
LEFT JOIN observations o ON p.project_id = o.project_id
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status;

CREATE TRIGGER after_observation_insert
AFTER INSERT ON observations
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN

    SET t.observation_count = (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations o WHERE o.taxon_id = t.taxon_id
    )
    WHERE t.taxon_id = NEW.taxon_id;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Trigger to validate environmental data
DELIMITER //
CREATE TRIGGER before_env_data_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON environmental_data
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    -- Validate temperature
    IF NEW.temperature_c < -2 OR NEW.temperature_c > 40 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Temperature out of valid range (-2 to 40°C)'; 
    END IF;
    
    -- Validate salinity
    IF NEW.salinity_psu < 0 OR NEW.salinity_psu > 40 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Salinity out of valid range (0 to 40 PSU)'; 
    END IF;
    
    -- Validate oxygen
    IF NEW.oxygen_ml_l < 0 OR NEW.oxygen_ml_l > 10 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Oxygen out of valid range (0 to 10 ml/L)'; 
    END IF;
    
    -- Validate pH
    IF NEW.ph < 0 OR NEW.ph > 14 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
        SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'pH out of valid range (0 to 14)'; 
    END IF;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Create functions

-- Function to calculate distance between two points (Haversine formula)
DELIMITER //
CREATE FUNCTION haversine_distance(
    lat1 DECIMAL(10,6),
    lon1 DECIMAL(10,6),
    lat2 DECIMAL(10,6),
    lon2 DECIMAL(10,6)
)
RETURNS DECIMAL(10,2)
DETERMINISTIC
BEGIN
    DECLARE r DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 6371; -- Earth radius in km
    DECLARE phi1 DECIMAL(10,6);
    DECLARE phi2 DECIMAL(10,6);
    DECLARE delta_phi DECIMAL(10,6);
    DECLARE delta_lambda DECIMAL(10,6);
    DECLARE a DECIMAL(20,10);
    DECLARE c DECIMAL(20,10);
    DECLARE d DECIMAL(10,2);
    
    SET phi1 = RADIANS(lat1);
    SET phi2 = RADIANS(lat2);
    SET delta_phi = RADIANS(lat2 - lat1);
    SET delta_lambda = RADIANS(lon2 - lon1);
    
    SET a = SIN(delta_phi/2) * SIN(delta_phi/2) +
           COS(phi1) * COS(phi2) *
           SIN(delta_lambda/2) * SIN(delta_lambda/2);
    
    SET c = 2 * ATAN2(SQRT(a), SQRT(1-a));
    SET d = r * c;
    
    RETURN d;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Function to get species by environmental parameters
DELIMITER //
CREATE FUNCTION get_species_by_env(
    p_temperature_c DECIMAL(5,2),
    p_salinity_psu DECIMAL(5,2),
    p_depth_m DECIMAL(10,2)
)
RETURNS TEXT
DETERMINISTIC
BEGIN
    DECLARE result TEXT;
    
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.species SEPARATOR ', ') INTO result
    FROM taxonomy t
    JOIN species_characteristics sc ON t.taxon_id = sc.taxon_id
    WHERE p_temperature_c BETWEEN sc.temperature_range_min_c AND sc.temperature_range_max_c
    AND p_salinity_psu BETWEEN sc.salinity_range_min_psu AND sc.salinity_range_max_psu
    AND p_depth_m BETWEEN sc.depth_range_min_m AND sc.depth_range_max_m;
    
    RETURN result;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Create a stored procedure to export data for analysis
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE export_species_data(
    IN p_species_name VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_start_date DATE,
    IN p_end_date DATE
)
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        o.observation_id,
        o.observation_date,
        o.latitude,
        o.longitude,
        o.depth_m,
        o.quantity,
        o.quantity_type,
        e.temperature_c,
        e.salinity_psu,
        e.oxygen_ml_l,
        e.ph,
        s.station_name,
        r.project_name,
        t.species,
        t.common_name
    FROM observations o
    JOIN environmental_data e ON o.observation_id = e.observation_id
    JOIN sampling_stations s ON o.station_id = s.station_id
    JOIN research_projects r ON o.project_id = r.project_id
    JOIN taxonomy t ON o.taxon_id = t.taxon_id
    WHERE t.species = p_species_name
    AND o.observation_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
    ORDER BY o.observation_date;
END //
DELIMITER ;

-- Optimize tables
OPTIMIZE TABLE taxonomy, species_characteristics, research_projects, 
               sampling_stations, observations, environmental_data, 
               sampling_methods, observation_methods, observation_media;

-- Create a summary report
SELECT 
    'Database Summary' AS report_title,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM taxonomy) AS species_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations) AS observation_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_projects) AS project_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sampling_stations) AS station_count,
    (SELECT MIN(observation_date) FROM observations) AS first_observation_date,
    (SELECT MAX(observation_date) FROM observations) AS last_observation_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations WHERE observation_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) AS observations_last_year;

-- Example queries

-- Get all observations of a specific species
CALL get_species_distribution(1, '2000-01-01', '2023-12-31', 0, 100, -90, 90, -180, 180);

-- Find species that might be found in specific conditions
SELECT get_species_by_env(25.5, 35.0, 15) AS potential_species;

-- Get project summaries
SELECT * FROM project_summaries;

-- Export data for a specific species
CALL export_species_data('ocellaris', '2010-01-01', '2023-12-31');

# MarineEcosystemModel.py
# Python implementation of a marine ecosystem model with multiple interacting species

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.integrate import odeint
from scipy.optimize import fsolve
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d
from multiprocessing import Pool
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime

# Constants
SECONDS_PER_DAY = 86400
DAYS_PER_YEAR = 365
MODEL_DURATION_YEARS = 50
TIME_STEPS_PER_DAY = 4
TOTAL_TIME_STEPS = MODEL_DURATION_YEARS * DAYS_PER_YEAR * TIME_STEPS_PER_DAY

# Environmental parameters
ENV_PARAMS = {
    'temperature': {
        'mean': 15.0,  # °C
        'amplitude': 8.0,  # °C
        'phase': 0.0,  # days
        'period': DAYS_PER_YEAR  # days
    },
    'salinity': {
        'mean': 35.0,  # PSU
        'amplitude': 2.0,  # PSU
        'phase': 30.0,  # days
        'period': DAYS_PER_YEAR  # days
    },
    'oxygen': {
        'mean': 7.0,  # ml/L
        'amplitude': 1.5,  # ml/L
        'phase': 60.0,  # days
        'period': DAYS_PER_YEAR  # days
    },
    'nutrients': {
        'mean': 10.0,  # μmol/L
        'amplitude': 5.0,  # μmol/L
        'phase': 90.0,  # days
        'period': DAYS_PER_YEAR  # days
    }
}

# Species parameters structure
SPECIES_PARAMS = {
    'phytoplankton': {
        'type': 'primary_producer',
        'initial_biomass': 0.1,  # gC/m³
        'max_growth_rate': 2.0,  # 1/day
        'light_half_saturation': 50.0,  # W/m²
        'nutrient_half_saturation': 0.5,  # μmol/L
        'temperature_optimum': 20.0,  # °C
        'temperature_tolerance': 10.0,  # °C
        'mortality_rate': 0.05,  # 1/day
        'respiration_rate': 0.1,  # 1/day
        'settling_velocity': 0.1,  # m/day
        'grazing_vulnerability': 0.8
    },
    'zooplankton': {
        'type': 'consumer',
        'initial_biomass': 0.05,  # gC/m³
        'max_growth_rate': 0.8,  # 1/day
        'grazing_rate': 0.5,  # m³/gC/day
        'assimilation_efficiency': 0.7,
        'temperature_optimum': 15.0,  # °C
        'temperature_tolerance': 8.0,  # °C
        'mortality_rate': 0.02,  # 1/day
        'respiration_rate': 0.05,  # 1/day
        'predation_vulnerability': 0.6,
        'prey': ['phytoplankton']
    },
    'small_fish': {
        'type': 'consumer',
        'initial_biomass': 0.02,  # gC/m³
        'max_growth_rate': 0.3,  # 1/day
        'grazing_rate': 0.2,  # m³/gC/day
        'assimilation_efficiency': 0.8,
        'temperature_optimum': 18.0,  # °C
        'temperature_tolerance': 6.0,  # °C
        'mortality_rate': 0.01,  # 1/day
        'respiration_rate': 0.03,  # 1/day
        'predation_vulnerability': 0.7,
        'prey': ['zooplankton']
    },
    'large_fish': {
        'type': 'consumer',
        'initial_biomass': 0.01,  # gC/m³
        'max_growth_rate': 0.2,  # 1/day
        'grazing_rate': 0.1,  # m³/gC/day
        'assimilation_efficiency': 0.85,
        'temperature_optimum': 20.0,  # °C
        'temperature_tolerance': 5.0,  # °C
        'mortality_rate': 0.005,  # 1/day
        'respiration_rate': 0.02,  # 1/day
        'predation_vulnerability': 0.3,
        'prey': ['small_fish']
    },
    'detritus': {
        'type': 'detritus',
        'initial_biomass': 0.05,  # gC/m³
        'remineralization_rate': 0.05,  # 1/day
        'settling_velocity': 1.0,  # m/day
        'temperature_effect': 0.05  # 1/°C
    }
}

# Fishing parameters
FISHING_PARAMS = {
    'small_fish': {
        'fishing_mortality': 0.001,  # 1/day
        'season_start': 90,  # day of year
        'season_end': 270,  # day of year
        'selectivity': 0.8  # size selectivity
    },
    'large_fish': {
        'fishing_mortality': 0.002,  # 1/day
        'season_start': 120,  # day of year
        'season_end': 300,  # day of year
        'selectivity': 0.9  # size selectivity
    }
}

# Model class
class MarineEcosystemModel:
    def __init__(self, depth=100, area=1e6, volume=1e8):
        """
        Initialize the marine ecosystem model.
        
        Parameters:
        - depth: water column depth in meters
        - area: surface area in m²
        - volume: water volume in m³
        """
        self.depth = depth
        self.area = area
        self.volume = volume
        
        # Time parameters
        self.time_step = 1.0 / TIME_STEPS_PER_DAY  # days
        self.time_steps = TOTAL_TIME_STEPS
        self.time = np.arange(0, MODEL_DURATION_YEARS * DAYS_PER_YEAR, self.time_step)
        
        # Environmental conditions
        self.environment = {}
        self.initialize_environment()
        
        # Species
        self.species = list(SPECIES_PARAMS.keys())
        self.species_types = {s: SPECIES_PARAMS[s]['type'] for s in self.species}
        
        # Initialize biomass
        self.biomass = np.zeros((len(self.species), self.time_steps))
        self.initialize_biomass()
        
        # Initialize fishing
        self.fishing = {s: FISHING_PARAMS.get(s, {}) for s in self.species}
        
        # Results storage
        self.results = {}
        
        # Create output directory
        self.output_dir = f"model_results_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
        os.makedirs(self.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    def initialize_environment(self):
        """Initialize environmental conditions."""
        for param, values in ENV_PARAMS.items():
            # Create time series with seasonal variation
            self.environment[param] = (
                values['mean'] +
                values['amplitude'] * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (self.time - values['phase']) / values['period'])
            )
        
        # Light availability (simplified)
        self.environment['light'] = 200 * (1 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * (self.time - 80) / DAYS_PER_YEAR))
    
    def initialize_biomass(self):
        """Initialize biomass for all species."""
        for i, species in enumerate(self.species):
            self.biomass[i, 0] = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]['initial_biomass']
    
    def temperature_effect(self, species, t):
        """
        Calculate temperature effect on growth rate.
        
        Parameters:
        - species: species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Temperature effect (0-1)
        """
        params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
        temp = self.environment['temperature'][t]
        
        # Gaussian temperature response
        return np.exp(-((temp - params['temperature_optimum']) / params['temperature_tolerance'])**2)
    
    def light_limitation(self, species, t):
        """
        Calculate light limitation for primary producers.
        
        Parameters:
        - species: species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Light limitation factor (0-1)
        """
        if self.species_types[species] != 'primary_producer':
            return 1.0
            
        params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
        light = self.environment['light'][t]
        
        # Monod kinetics
        return light / (light + params['light_half_saturation'])
    
    def nutrient_limitation(self, species, t):
        """
        Calculate nutrient limitation for primary producers.
        
        Parameters:
        - species: species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Nutrient limitation factor (0-1)
        """
        if self.species_types[species] != 'primary_producer':
            return 1.0
            
        params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
        nutrients = self.environment['nutrients'][t]
        
        # Monod kinetics
        return nutrients / (nutrients + params['nutrient_half_saturation'])
    
    def grazing_rate(self, predator, prey, t):
        """
        Calculate grazing rate of predator on prey.
        
        Parameters:
        - predator: predator species name
        - prey: prey species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Grazing rate (1/day)
        """
        predator_params = SPECIES_PARAMS[predator]
        prey_params = SPECIES_PARAMS[prey]
        
        # Base grazing rate
        rate = predator_params['grazing_rate'] * self.biomass[self.species.index(prey), t]
        
        # Temperature effect
        rate *= self.temperature_effect(predator, t)
        
        # Prey vulnerability
        rate *= prey_params['grazing_vulnerability']
        
        return rate
    
    def predation_mortality(self, prey, t):
        """
        Calculate predation mortality for a prey species.
        
        Parameters:
        - prey: prey species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Predation mortality rate (1/day)
        """
        prey_params = SPECIES_PARAMS[prey]
        mortality = 0.0
        
        # Sum predation from all predators
        for predator in self.species:
            if self.species_types[predator] == 'consumer' and prey in SPECIES_PARAMS[predator].get('prey', []):
                mortality += self.grazing_rate(predator, prey, t) * self.biomass[self.species.index(predator), t]
        
        return mortality * prey_params['predation_vulnerability']
    
    def fishing_mortality(self, species, t):
        """
        Calculate fishing mortality for a species.
        
        Parameters:
        - species: species name
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Fishing mortality rate (1/day)
        """
        if species not in self.fishing:
            return 0.0
            
        params = self.fishing[species]
        day_of_year = int(self.time[t] % DAYS_PER_YEAR)
        
        # Seasonal fishing
        if params['season_start'] <= day_of_year <= params['season_end']:
            return params['fishing_mortality'] * params['selectivity']
        else:
            return 0.0
    
    def remineralization(self, t):
        """
        Calculate detritus remineralization rate.
        
        Parameters:
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Remineralization rate (1/day)
        """
        detritus_params = SPECIES_PARAMS['detritus']
        temp = self.environment['temperature'][t]
        
        return detritus_params['remineralization_rate'] * (1 + detritus_params['temperature_effect'] * (temp - 10))
    
    def dbiomass_dt(self, biomass, t):
        """
        Calculate the rate of change of biomass for all species.
        
        Parameters:
        - biomass: current biomass of all species
        - t: time index
        
        Returns:
        - Array of biomass change rates
        """
        dBdt = np.zeros(len(self.species))
        
        for i, species in enumerate(self.species):
            if self.species_types[species] == 'primary_producer':
                # Primary producers
                params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
                
                # Growth
                growth = (params['max_growth_rate'] * 
                          self.temperature_effect(species, t) *
                          self.light_limitation(species, t) *
                          self.nutrient_limitation(species, t) *
                          biomass[i])
                
                # Losses
                losses = (params['mortality_rate'] * biomass[i] + 
                          params['respiration_rate'] * biomass[i] + 
                          self.predation_mortality(species, t) * biomass[i])
                
                dBdt[i] = growth - losses
                
            elif self.species_types[species] == 'consumer':
                # Consumers
                params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
                
                # Growth from grazing
                growth = 0.0
                for prey in params['prey']:
                    j = self.species.index(prey)
                    grazing = self.grazing_rate(species, prey, t) * biomass[j]
                    growth += grazing * biomass[i] * params['assimilation_efficiency']
                
                # Losses
                losses = (params['mortality_rate'] * biomass[i] + 
                          params['respiration_rate'] * biomass[i] + 
                          self.predation_mortality(species, t) * biomass[i] + 
                          self.fishing_mortality(species, t) * biomass[i])
                
                dBdt[i] = growth - losses
                
            elif self.species_types[species] == 'detritus':
                # Detritus
                params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
                
                # Input from mortality and predation
                input_rate = 0.0
                for s in self.species:
                    if s != 'detritus':
                        s_params = SPECIES_PARAMS[s]
                        input_rate += (s_params['mortality_rate'] * biomass[self.species.index(s)] +
                                      self.predation_mortality(s, t) * biomass[self.species.index(s)])
                
                # Losses from remineralization and settling
                losses = (self.remineralization(t) * biomass[i] +
                          params['settling_velocity'] / self.depth * biomass[i])
                
                dBdt[i] = input_rate - losses
        
        return dBdt
    
    def run_model(self):
        """Run the ecosystem model."""
        print("Running marine ecosystem model...")
        
        # Integrate the model
        self.biomass = odeint(self.dbiomass_dt, self.biomass[:, 0], self.time)
        
        # Store results
        self.results['time'] = self.time
        self.results['biomass'] = self.biomass
        self.results['environment'] = {k: v for k, v in self.environment.items()}
        
        print("Model run completed.")
    
    def analyze_results(self):
        """Analyze model results."""
        print("Analyzing results...")
        
        # Calculate statistics
        stats = {}
        for i, species in enumerate(self.species):
            stats[species] = {
                'mean': np.mean(self.biomass[i, :]),
                'std': np.std(self.biomass[i, :]),
                'min': np.min(self.biomass[i, :]),
                'max': np.max(self.biomass[i, :]),
                'final': self.biomass[i, -1]
            }
        
        self.results['statistics'] = stats
        
        # Calculate trophic levels
        self.results['trophic_levels'] = self.calculate_trophic_levels()
        
        # Calculate ecosystem metrics
        self.results['metrics'] = self.calculate_ecosystem_metrics()
        
        print("Analysis completed.")
    
    def calculate_trophic_levels(self):
        """Calculate trophic levels for each species."""
        trophic_levels = {}
        
        # Base level for primary producers
        for species in self.species:
            if self.species_types[species] == 'primary_producer':
                trophic_levels[species] = 1.0
        
        # Calculate for consumers
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for species in self.species:
                if self.species_types[species] == 'consumer' and species not in trophic_levels:
                    params = SPECIES_PARAMS[species]
                    prey_levels = []
                    
                    for prey in params['prey']:
                        if prey in trophic_levels:
                            prey_levels.append(trophic_levels[prey])
                    
                    if len(prey_levels) == len(params['prey']):
                        # Average trophic level of prey + 1
                        trophic_levels[species] = np.mean(prey_levels) + 1
                        changed = True
        
        return trophic_levels
    
    def calculate_ecosystem_metrics(self):
        """Calculate ecosystem-level metrics."""
        metrics = {}
        
        # Total biomass
        total_biomass = np.sum(self.biomass, axis=0)
        metrics['total_biomass'] = {
            'mean': np.mean(total_biomass),
            'std': np.std(total_biomass),
            'min': np.min(total_biomass),
            'max': np.max(total_biomass)
        }
        
        # Biodiversity (Shannon index)
        shannon = np.zeros(self.time_steps)
        for t in range(self.time_steps):
            # Normalize biomass to get proportions
            proportions = self.biomass[:, t] / np.sum(self.biomass[:, t])
            # Calculate Shannon index
            shannon[t] = -np.sum(proportions * np.log(proportions + 1e-10))
        
        metrics['biodiversity'] = {
            'mean': np.mean(shannon),
            'std': np.std(shannon),
            'min': np.min(shannon),
            'max': np.max(shannon)
        }
        
        # Primary production
        pp_indices = [i for i, s in enumerate(self.species) 
                      if self.species_types[s] == 'primary_producer']
        primary_production = np.sum(self.biomass[pp_indices, :], axis=0)
        
        metrics['primary_production'] = {
            'mean': np.mean(primary_production),
            'std': np.std(primary_production),
            'min': np.min(primary_production),
            'max': np.max(primary_production)
        }
        
        # Fisheries yield
        fish_indices = [i for i, s in enumerate(self.species) 
                        if self.species_types[s] == 'consumer' and s in self.fishing]
        fisheries_yield = np.zeros(self.time_steps)
        
        for t in range(self.time_steps):
            for i in fish_indices:
                species = self.species[i]
                fishing_mort = self.fishing_mortality(species, t)
                fisheries_yield[t] += fishing_mort * self.biomass[i, t] * self.volume
        
        metrics['fisheries_yield'] = {
            'mean': np.mean(fisheries_yield),
            'std': np.std(fisheries_yield),
            'min': np.min(fisheries_yield),
            'max': np.max(fisheries_yield),
            'total': np.sum(fisheries_yield)
        }
        
        return metrics
    
    def plot_results(self):
        """Create plots of model results."""
        print("Creating plots...")
        
        # Biomass time series
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
        for i, species in enumerate(self.species):
            plt.plot(self.time / DAYS_PER_YEAR, self.biomass[i, :], label=species)
        
        plt.xlabel('Years')
        plt.ylabel('Biomass (gC/m³)')
        plt.title('Species Biomass Over Time')
        plt.legend()
        plt.grid(True)
        plt.savefig(f"{self.output_dir}/biomass_time_series.png")
        plt.close()
        
        # Environmental conditions
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
        for param in ['temperature', 'salinity', 'oxygen', 'nutrients']:
            plt.plot(self.time / DAYS_PER_YEAR, self.environment[param], 
                     label=param.capitalize())
        
        plt.xlabel('Years')
        plt.ylabel('Value')
        plt.title('Environmental Conditions Over Time')
        plt.legend()
        plt.grid(True)
        plt.savefig(f"{self.output_dir}/environmental_conditions.png")
        plt.close()
        
        # Biomass by trophic level
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
        trophic_levels = self.results['trophic_levels']
        
        for species in self.species:
            if species in trophic_levels:
                i = self.species.index(species)
                plt.scatter(trophic_levels[species], 
                            self.results['statistics'][species]['mean'],
                            label=species)
        
        plt.xlabel('Trophic Level')
        plt.ylabel('Mean Biomass (gC/m³)')
        plt.title('Biomass by Trophic Level')
        plt.grid(True)
        plt.savefig(f"{self.output_dir}/biomass_trophic_level.png")
        plt.close()
        
        # Ecosystem metrics
        metrics = self.results['metrics']
        
        plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
        plt.plot(self.time / DAYS_PER_YEAR, 
                 np.sum(self.biomass, axis=0), label='Total Biomass')
        
        # Calculate biodiversity over time
        biodiversity = np.zeros(self.time_steps)
        for t in range(self.time_steps):
            proportions = self.biomass[:, t] / np.sum(self.biomass[:, t])
            biodiversity[t] = -np.sum(proportions * np.log(proportions + 1e-10))
        
        plt.plot(self.time / DAYS_PER_YEAR, biodiversity, label='Biodiversity')
        plt.xlabel('Years')
        plt.ylabel('Value')
        plt.title('Ecosystem Metrics Over Time')
        plt.legend()
        plt.grid(True)
        plt.savefig(f"{self.output_dir}/ecosystem_metrics.png")
        plt.close()
        
        print("Plots created.")
    
    def save_results(self):
        """Save model results to files."""
        print("Saving results...")
        
        # Save parameters
        with open(f"{self.output_dir}/model_parameters.json", 'w') as f:
            json.dump({
                'species_params': SPECIES_PARAMS,
                'fishing_params': FISHING_PARAMS,
                'env_params': ENV_PARAMS,
                'model_config': {
                    'depth': self.depth,
                    'area': self.area,
                    'volume': self.volume,
                    'duration_years': MODEL_DURATION_YEARS,
                    'time_steps_per_day': TIME_STEPS_PER_DAY
                }
            }, f, indent=2)
        
        # Save time series
        time_series = pd.DataFrame({
            'time': self.time,
            **{species: self.biomass[i, :] for i, species in enumerate(self.species)},
            **{f"env_{param}": values for param, values in self.environment.items()}
        })
        
        time_series.to_csv(f"{self.output_dir}/time_series.csv", index=False)
        
        # Save statistics
        stats_df = pd.DataFrame(self.results['statistics']).T
        stats_df.to_csv(f"{self.output_dir}/species_statistics.csv")
        
        # Save metrics
        metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(self.results['metrics']).T
        metrics_df.to_csv(f"{self.output_dir}/ecosystem_metrics.csv")
        
        # Save trophic levels
        with open(f"{self.output_dir}/trophic_levels.json", 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.results['trophic_levels'], f, indent=2)
        
        print("Results saved.")
    
    def run_sensitivity_analysis(self, param_ranges, n_samples=100):
        """
        Run sensitivity analysis by varying parameters.
        
        Parameters:
        - param_ranges: dictionary of parameter ranges to vary
        - n_samples: number of samples to generate
        """
        print("Running sensitivity analysis...")
        
        # Generate parameter samples
        samples = []
        for _ in range(n_samples):
            sample = {}
            
            for param, range_info in param_ranges.items():
                if isinstance(range_info, dict):
                    # Parameter is in a species
                    species = param.split('.')[0]
                    param_name = param.split('.')[1]
                    
                    if species not in sample:
                        sample[species] = {}
                    
                    if range_info['type'] == 'uniform':
                        sample[species][param_name] = np.random.uniform(
                            range_info['min'], range_info['max'])
                    elif range_info['type'] == 'normal':
                        sample[species][param_name] = np.random.normal(
                            range_info['mean'], range_info['std'])
                else:
                    # Parameter is in environment
                    if range_info['type'] == 'uniform':
                        sample[param] = np.random.uniform(
                            range_info['min'], range_info['max'])
                    elif range_info['type'] == 'normal':
                        sample[param] = np.random.normal(
                            range_info['mean'], range_info['std'])
            
            samples.append(sample)
        
        # Run model for each sample
        sensitivity_results = []
        
        for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
            print(f"Running sample {i+1}/{n_samples}")
            
            # Create a new model instance
            model = MarineEcosystemModel(depth=self.depth, area=self.area, volume=self.volume)
            
            # Apply parameter changes
            for species, params in sample.items():
                if species in model.species:
                    for param, value in params.items():
                        if param in SPECIES_PARAMS[species]:
                            SPECIES_PARAMS[species][param] = value
                else:
                    if species in ENV_PARAMS:
                        ENV_PARAMS[species]['mean'] = sample[species]
            
            # Run model
            model.run_model()
            model.analyze_results()
            
            # Store results
            result = {
                'sample': sample,
                'statistics': model.results['statistics'],
                'metrics': model.results['metrics']
            }
            sensitivity_results.append(result)
        
        # Save sensitivity analysis results
        with open(f"{self.output_dir}/sensitivity_analysis.json", 'w') as f:
            json.dump(sensitivity_results, f, indent=2)
        
        print("Sensitivity analysis completed.")
        
        return sensitivity_results
    
    def run_scenario(self, scenario_name, scenario_func):
        """
        Run a specific scenario by modifying the model.
        
        Parameters:
        - scenario_name: name of the scenario
        - scenario_func: function that modifies the model
        """
        print(f"Running scenario: {scenario_name}")
        
        # Create a new model instance
        scenario_model = MarineEcosystemModel(depth=self.depth, area=self.area, volume=self.volume)
        
        # Apply scenario modifications
        scenario_func(scenario_model)
        
        # Run model
        scenario_model.run_model()
        scenario_model.analyze_results()
        
        # Create scenario directory
        scenario_dir = f"{self.output_dir}/{scenario_name}"
        os.makedirs(scenario_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Save results
        scenario_model.output_dir = scenario_dir
        scenario_model.save_results()
        scenario_model.plot_results()
        
        print(f"Scenario {scenario_name} completed.")
        
        return scenario_model

# Scenario definitions
def climate_change_scenario(model):
    """Scenario with increased temperature and decreased oxygen."""
    # Increase temperature by 2°C over 50 years
    original_temp = ENV_PARAMS['temperature']['mean']
    temp_increase = np.linspace(0, 2, len(model.time))
    model.environment['temperature'] = original_temp + temp_increase
    
    # Decrease oxygen by 10%
    model.environment['oxygen'] *= 0.9
    
    # Increase nutrient loading
    model.environment['nutrients'] *= 1.2

def overfishing_scenario(model):
    """Scenario with increased fishing pressure."""
    # Double fishing mortality for all fish
    for species in model.fishing:
        model.fishing[species]['fishing_mortality'] *= 2

def marine_protected_area_scenario(model):
    """Scenario with reduced fishing in a marine protected area."""
    # Reduce fishing mortality by 90% for all fish
    for species in model.fishing:
        model.fishing[species]['fishing_mortality'] *= 0.1

def invasive_species_scenario(model):
    """Scenario with an invasive species added."""
    # Add invasive species
    invasive_params = {
        'invasive_species': {
            'type': 'consumer',
            'initial_biomass': 0.001,  # gC/m³
            'max_growth_rate': 0.5,  # 1/day
            'grazing_rate': 0.3,  # m³/gC/day
            'assimilation_efficiency': 0.75,
            'temperature_optimum': 22.0,  # °C
            'temperature_tolerance': 8.0,  # °C
            'mortality_rate': 0.01,  # 1/day
            'respiration_rate': 0.04,  # 1/day
            'predation_vulnerability': 0.2,
            'prey': ['zooplankton', 'small_fish']
        }
    }
    
    # Update model parameters
    SPECIES_PARAMS.update(invasive_params)
    model.species = list(SPECIES_PARAMS.keys())
    model.species_types = {s: SPECIES_PARAMS[s]['type'] for s in model.species}
    
    # Reinitialize biomass
    model.biomass = np.zeros((len(model.species), model.time_steps))
    model.initialize_biomass()

# Main function
def main():
    # Initialize model
    model = MarineEcosystemModel(depth=100, area=1e6, volume=1e8)
    
    # Run baseline model
    model.run_model()
    model.analyze_results()
    model.plot_results()
    model.save_results()
    
    # Run sensitivity analysis
    param_ranges = {
        'phytoplankton.max_growth_rate': {'type': 'uniform', 'min': 1.5, 'max': 2.5},
        'zooplankton.grazing_rate': {'type': 'uniform', 'min': 0.3, 'max': 0.7},
        'small_fish.mortality_rate': {'type': 'uniform', 'min': 0.005, 'max': 0.015},
        'temperature': {'type': 'uniform', 'min': 10, 'max': 20},
        'nutrients': {'type': 'uniform', 'min': 5, 'max': 15}
    }
    
    sensitivity_results = model.run_sensitivity_analysis(param_ranges, n_samples=50)
    
    # Run scenarios
    scenarios = {
        'climate_change': climate_change_scenario,
        'overfishing': overfishing_scenario,
        'marine_protected_area': marine_protected_area_scenario,
        'invasive_species': invasive_species_scenario
    }
    
    for name, scenario_func in scenarios.items():
        model.run_scenario(name, scenario_func)
    
    print("All model runs completed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# MarineSpeciesDistributionModel.R
# R script for modeling marine species distributions using various statistical and machine learning methods

# Load required libraries
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(gbm)
library(xgboost)
library(ggmap)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(rgdal)
library(terra)
library(ENMeval)
library(dismo)
library(biomod2)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(pROC)
library(mlr)
library(viridis)
library(plotly)

# Set up parallel processing
cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)

# Configuration
config <- list(
    input_dir = "data/species_data",
    output_dir = "results/species_distribution",
    env_data_dir = "data/environmental",
    target_species = c("Thunnus_albacares", "Carcharhinus_longimanus", 
                      "Megaptera_novaeangliae", "Acropora_millepora"),
    test_proportion = 0.2,
    k_folds = 5,
    models_to_run = c("glm", "rf", "gbm", "maxent", "bioclim"),
    resolution = 0.1,  # degrees
    extent = c(-180, 180, -90, 90),
    crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs",
    threshold_method = "max_tss",  # "max_tss", "max_kappa", "prevalence"
    evaluation_metrics = c("AUC", "TSS", "Kappa", "Sensitivity", "Specificity")
)

# Create output directory
if (!dir.exists(config$output_dir)) {
    dir.create(config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Helper functions

# Function to load species occurrence data
load_species_data <- function(species_name) {
    file_pattern <- paste0("*", species_name, "*.csv")
    files <- list.files(path = config$input_dir, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if (length(files) == 0) {
        warning(paste("No files found for species:", species_name))
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Read and combine all files for this species
    data_list <- lapply(files, function(file) {
        df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        df$species <- species_name
        df
    })
    
    species_data <- bind_rows(data_list)
    
    # Clean data
    species_data <- species_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) %>%
        filter(latitude >= -90 & latitude <= 90) %>%
        filter(longitude >= -180 & longitude <= 180) %>%
        distinct(latitude, longitude, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(presence = 1)
    
    # Add pseudo-absence points (same number as presence points)
    if (nrow(species_data) > 0) {
        set.seed(123)
        pseudo_absences <- data.frame(
            latitude = runif(nrow(species_data), min = -90, max = 90),
            longitude = runif(nrow(species_data), min = -180, max = 180),
            presence = 0
        )
        
        # Ensure pseudo-absences are not too close to presence points
        coords <- species_data %>% select(longitude, latitude)
        tree <- sp::spDists(coords, longlat = TRUE)
        
        # Find pseudo-absences that are at least 1 degree away from any presence point
        valid_pa <- apply(pseudo_absences[, 1:2], 1, function(pa) {
            min_dist <- min(sp::spDists(matrix(pa, ncol = 2), coords, longlat = TRUE))
            min_dist >= 1
        })
        
        pseudo_absences <- pseudo_absences[valid_pa, ]
        
        # Combine presence and pseudo-absence data
        species_data <- bind_rows(species_data, pseudo_absences)
    }
    
    return(species_data)
}

# Function to load environmental data
load_environmental_data <- function() {
    env_files <- list.files(path = config$env_data_dir, pattern = "*.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
    
    if (length(env_files) == 0) {
        stop("No environmental data files found in directory:", config$env_data_dir)
    }
    
    # Read all environmental layers
    env_stack <- rast(env_files)
    
    # Get layer names from file names
    layer_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(env_files))
    names(env_stack) <- layer_names
    
    # Resample to consistent resolution if needed
    if (res(env_stack)[1] != config$resolution) {
        env_stack <- terra::resample(env_stack, rast(ext(config$extent), resolution = config$resolution, crs = config$crs))
    }
    
    return(env_stack)
}

# Function to extract environmental data for points
extract_env_data <- function(points, env_stack) {
    # Convert points to spatial object
    coords <- points %>% select(longitude, latitude)
    sp_points <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string = CRS(config$crs))
    
    # Extract values
    env_values <- terra::extract(env_stack, vect(sp_points))
    
    # Combine with original data
    result <- cbind(points, env_values)
    
    return(result)
}

# Function to prepare data for modeling
prepare_model_data <- function(species_data, env_stack) {
    # Extract environmental data for all points
    model_data <- extract_env_data(species_data, env_stack)
    
    # Remove rows with NA values
    model_data <- model_data %>% na.omit()
    
    # Split into training and testing sets
    set.seed(123)
    train_indices <- createDataPartition(model_data$presence, p = 1 - config$test_proportion, list = FALSE)
    
    train_data <- model_data[train_indices, ]
    test_data <- model_data[-train_indices, ]
    
    return(list(train = train_data, test = test_data))
}

# Function to train and evaluate a single model
train_model <- function(model_type, train_data, test_data, species_name) {
    # Prepare data
    x_train <- train_data %>% select(-c(presence, latitude, longitude))
    y_train <- train_data$presence
    
    x_test <- test_data %>% select(-c(presence, latitude, longitude))
    y_test <- test_data$presence
    
    # Train model based on type
    if (model_type == "glm") {
        # Generalized Linear Model
        model <- glm(presence ~ ., data = cbind(y_train, x_train), family = binomial())
        
        # Make predictions
        pred_train <- predict(model, newdata = x_train, type = "response")
        pred_test <- predict(model, newdata = x_test, type = "response")
        
    } else if (model_type == "rf") {
        # Random Forest
        ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = config$k_folds, classProbs = TRUE)
        model <- train(x = x_train, y = y_train, method = "rf", trControl = ctrl,
                      tuneLength = 5, importance = TRUE)
        
        # Make predictions
        pred_train <- predict(model, newdata = x_train, type = "prob")[,2]
        pred_test <- predict(model, newdata = x_test, type = "prob")[,2]
        
    } else if (model_type == "gbm") {
        # Gradient Boosting Machine
        ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = config$k_folds, classProbs = TRUE)
        model <- train(x = x_train, y = y_train, method = "gbm", trControl = ctrl,
                      tuneLength = 5, verbose = FALSE)
        
        # Make predictions
        pred_train <- predict(model, newdata = x_train, type = "prob")[,2]
        pred_test <- predict(model, newdata = x_test, type = "prob")[,2]
        
    } else if (model_type == "maxent") {
        # Maxent (using dismo package)
        # Prepare presence data
        pres_coords <- train_data %>% filter(presence == 1) %>% select(longitude, latitude)
        
        # Prepare background data (all points)
        bg_coords <- train_data %>% select(longitude, latitude)
        
        # Train model
        model <- maxent(env_stack, p = pres_coords, a = bg_coords)
        
        # Make predictions
        pred_train <- predict(model, train_data)
        pred_test <- predict(model, test_data)
        
    } else if (model_type == "bioclim") {
        # Bioclim (using dismo package)
        # Prepare presence data
        pres_coords <- train_data %>% filter(presence == 1) %>% select(longitude, latitude)
        
        # Train model
        model <- bioclim(env_stack, p = pres_coords)
        
        # Make predictions
        pred_train <- predict(model, train_data)
        pred_test <- predict(model, test_data)
        
    } else {
        stop(paste("Unknown model type:", model_type))
    }
    
    # Calculate evaluation metrics
    metrics <- calculate_metrics(y_train, pred_train, y_test, pred_test)
    
    # Return results
    return(list(
        model = model,
        predictions = list(train = pred_train, test = pred_test),
        metrics = metrics,
        model_type = model_type,
        species = species_name
    ))
}

# Function to calculate evaluation metrics
calculate_metrics <- function(y_train, pred_train, y_test, pred_test) {
    # Calculate thresholds
    thresholds <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
    
    # Calculate metrics for each threshold
    metric_df <- data.frame(threshold = thresholds)
    
    for (i in 1:length(thresholds)) {
        thresh <- thresholds[i]
        
        # Training metrics
        conf_matrix_train <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(pred_train >= thresh, 1, 0)), 
                                            factor(y_train), positive = "1")
        
        # Testing metrics
        conf_matrix_test <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(pred_test >= thresh, 1, 0)), 
                                           factor(y_test), positive = "1")
        
        # Store metrics
        metric_df$train_accuracy[i] <- conf_matrix_train$overall['Accuracy']
        metric_df$train_kappa[i] <- conf_matrix_train$overall['Kappa']
        metric_df$train_sensitivity[i] <- conf_matrix_train$byClass['Sensitivity']
        metric_df$train_specificity[i] <- conf_matrix_train$byClass['Specificity']
        metric_df$train_tss[i] <- metric_df$train_sensitivity[i] + metric_df$train_specificity[i] - 1
        
        metric_df$test_accuracy[i] <- conf_matrix_test$overall['Accuracy']
        metric_df$test_kappa[i] <- conf_matrix_test$overall['Kappa']
        metric_df$test_sensitivity[i] <- conf_matrix_test$byClass['Sensitivity']
        metric_df$test_specificity[i] <- conf_matrix_test$byClass['Specificity']
        metric_df$test_tss[i] <- metric_df$test_sensitivity[i] + metric_df$test_specificity[i] - 1
    }
    
    # Calculate AUC
    roc_train <- roc(y_train, pred_train)
    roc_test <- roc(y_test, pred_test)
    
    auc_train <- auc(roc_train)
    auc_test <- auc(roc_test)
    
    # Find optimal threshold
    if (config$threshold_method == "max_tss") {
        opt_thresh <- metric_df$threshold[which.max(metric_df$test_tss)]
    } else if (config$threshold_method == "max_kappa") {
        opt_thresh <- metric_df$threshold[which.max(metric_df$test_kappa)]
    } else if (config$threshold_method == "prevalence") {
        opt_thresh <- mean(y_train)  # prevalence in training data
    }
    
    # Get metrics at optimal threshold
    opt_metrics <- metric_df[metric_df$threshold == opt_thresh, ]
    
    # Prepare results
    metrics <- list(
        auc = list(train = auc_train, test = auc_test),
        tss = list(train = opt_metrics$train_tss, test = opt_metrics$test_tss),
        kappa = list(train = opt_metrics$train_kappa, test = opt_metrics$test_kappa),
        sensitivity = list(train = opt_metrics$train_sensitivity, test = opt_metrics$test_sensitivity),
        specificity = list(train = opt_metrics$train_specificity, test = opt_metrics$test_specificity),
        accuracy = list(train = opt_metrics$train_accuracy, test = opt_metrics$test_accuracy),
        optimal_threshold = opt_thresh,
        threshold_metrics = metric_df
    )
    
    return(metrics)
}

# Function to project model to entire study area
project_model <- function(model_result, env_stack) {
    model <- model_result$model
    model_type <- model_result$model_type
    
    # Project model
    if (model_type %in% c("glm", "rf", "gbm")) {
        # For machine learning models
        env_df <- as.data.frame(terra::as.matrix(env_stack))
        names(env_df) <- names(env_stack)
        
        # Make predictions
        if (model_type == "glm") {
            pred <- predict(model, newdata = env_df, type = "response")
        } else {
            pred <- predict(model, newdata = env_df, type = "prob")[,2]
        }
        
        # Convert to raster
        pred_raster <- rast(env_stack, 1)
        values(pred_raster) <- pred
        
    } else if (model_type %in% c("maxent", "bioclim")) {
        # For ecological niche models
        pred_raster <- predict(env_stack, model)
    }
    
    # Apply threshold
    threshold <- model_result$metrics$optimal_threshold
    pred_binary <- pred_raster > threshold
    
    return(list(
        probability = pred_raster,
        binary = pred_binary
    ))
}

# Function to create evaluation plots
create_evaluation_plots <- function(model_results, species_name) {
    # Create output directory for this species
    species_dir <- file.path(config$output_dir, species_name)
    if (!dir.exists(species_dir)) {
        dir.create(species_dir)
    }
    
    # 1. ROC Curve
    roc_plot <- ggplot() +
        geom_line(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model),
                  data = model_results$roc_data) +
        geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        labs(title = paste("ROC Curve -", species_name),
             x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", color = "Model") +
        theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(file.path(species_dir, "roc_curve.png"), roc_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
    
    # 2. Variable importance
    if (!is.null(model_results$var_importance)) {
        var_imp_plot <- ggplot(model_results$var_importance, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), y = Importance)) +
            geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
            coord_flip() +
            labs(title = paste("Variable Importance -", species_name),
                 x = "Variable", y = "Importance") +
            theme_minimal()
        
        ggsave(file.path(species_dir, "variable_importance.png"), var_imp_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
    }
    
    # 3. Response curves (for top variables)
    if (!is.null(model_results$response_curves)) {
        for (i in 1:length(model_results$response_curves)) {
            rc <- model_results$response_curves[[i]]
            rc_plot <- ggplot(rc, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
                geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
                geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), alpha = 0.2) +
                labs(title = paste("Response Curve -", names(model_results$response_curves)[i]),
                     x = names(model_results$response_curves)[i], y = "Probability of Presence") +
                theme_minimal()
            
            ggsave(file.path(species_dir, paste0("response_curve_", i, ".png")), rc_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
        }
    }
    
    # 4. Threshold metrics
    thresh_plot <- ggplot(model_results$threshold_metrics, 
                          aes(x = threshold, y = test_tss, color = "TSS")) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_line(aes(y = test_kappa, color = "Kappa")) +
        geom_line(aes(y = test_accuracy, color = "Accuracy")) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = model_results$optimal_threshold, linetype = "dashed") +
        labs(title = paste("Threshold Metrics -", species_name),
             x = "Threshold", y = "Metric Value", color = "Metric") +
        theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(file.path(species_dir, "threshold_metrics.png"), thresh_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
}

# Function to create distribution maps
create_distribution_maps <- function(projections, species_name, env_stack) {
    # Create output directory for this species
    species_dir <- file.path(config$output_dir, species_name)
    
    # Get environmental layers for background
    bathymetry <- rast(file.path(config$env_data_dir, "bathymetry.tif"))
    
    # 1. Probability map
    prob_map <- plot_ly() %>%
        add_raster(z = ~projections$probability, colors = viridis::viridis(100)) %>%
        add_contour(z = ~bathymetry, contours = list(color = ~"white", showlabels = TRUE),
                    name = "Bathymetry") %>%
        layout(title = paste("Predicted Probability -", species_name),
               xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
               yaxis = list(title = "Latitude"))
    
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(prob_map, file.path(species_dir, "probability_map.html"))
    
    # 2. Binary map
    binary_map <- plot_ly() %>%
        add_raster(z = ~projections$binary, colors = c("#f7fbff", "#08306b")) %>%
        add_contour(z = ~bathymetry, contours = list(color = ~"white", showlabels = TRUE),
                    name = "Bathymetry") %>%
        layout(title = paste("Binary Prediction -", species_name),
               xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
               yaxis = list(title = "Latitude"))
    
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(binary_map, file.path(species_dir, "binary_map.html"))
    
    # 3. Static probability map
    prob_ggplot <- ggplot() +
        geom_raster(data = as.data.frame(projections$probability, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
                    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = layer)) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
        borders("world", colour = "black", fill = NA) +
        coord_quickmap() +
        labs(title = paste("Predicted Probability -", species_name),
             x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", fill = "Probability") +
        theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(file.path(species_dir, "probability_map.png"), prob_ggplot, width = 10, height = 6)
    
    # 4. Static binary map
    binary_ggplot <- ggplot() +
        geom_raster(data = as.data.frame(projections$binary, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
                    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = layer)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#f7fbff", "1" = "#08306b")) +
        borders("world", colour = "black", fill = NA) +
        coord_quickmap() +
        labs(title = paste("Binary Prediction -", species_name),
             x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", fill = "Presence") +
        theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(file.path(species_dir, "binary_map.png"), binary_ggplot, width = 10, height = 6)
}

# Function to run ensemble modeling
run_ensemble <- function(model_results, env_stack) {
    # Extract probability rasters from all models
    prob_rasters <- lapply(model_results, function(result) {
        result$projections$probability
    })
    
    # Calculate ensemble mean
    ensemble_mean <- mean(prob_rasters[[1]])
    for (i in 2:length(prob_rasters)) {
        ensemble_mean <- ensemble_mean + prob_rasters[[i]]
    }
    ensemble_mean <- ensemble_mean / length(prob_rasters)
    
    # Calculate ensemble weighted by AUC
    auc_weights <- sapply(model_results, function(result) {
        result$metrics$auc$test
    })
    auc_weights <- auc_weights / sum(auc_weights)
    
    ensemble_weighted <- prob_rasters[[1]] * auc_weights[1]
    for (i in 2:length(prob_rasters)) {
        ensemble_weighted <- ensemble_weighted + prob_rasters[[i]] * auc_weights[i]
    }
    
    # Calculate binary predictions using optimal threshold from best model
    best_model_idx <- which.max(auc_weights)
    best_threshold <- model_results[[best_model_idx]]$metrics$optimal_threshold
    
    ensemble_binary <- ensemble_weighted > best_threshold
    
    return(list(
        mean = ensemble_mean,
        weighted = ensemble_weighted,
        binary = ensemble_binary
    ))
}

# Function to calculate model evaluation metrics for all models
calculate_model_evaluation <- function(model_results) {
    # Prepare data for ROC curve
    roc_data <- data.frame()
    
    for (result in model_results) {
        model_type <- result$model_type
        
        # Get test predictions and actual values
        pred_test <- result$predictions$test
        y_test <- ifelse(pred_test > 0.5, 1, 0)  # Convert probabilities to binary
        
        # Calculate ROC curve
        roc_obj <- roc(result$test_data$presence, pred_test)
        roc_df <- data.frame(
            sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
            specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
            model = model_type
        )
        
        roc_data <- bind_rows(roc_data, roc_df)
    }
    
    # Prepare variable importance data
    var_importance <- NULL
    if ("rf" %in% sapply(model_results, function(x) x$model_type)) {
        rf_result <- model_results[[which(sapply(model_results, function(x) x$model_type) == "rf")]]
        if (!is.null(rf_result$model$finalModel$importance)) {
            var_importance <- data.frame(
                Variable = rownames(rf_result$model$finalModel$importance),
                Importance = rf_result$model$finalModel$importance[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
            ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
        }
    }
    
    # Prepare response curves (for top 3 variables)
    response_curves <- list()
    if (!is.null(var_importance) && nrow(var_importance) > 0) {
        top_vars <- head(var_importance$Variable, 3)
        
        for (var in top_vars) {
            # Get range of values for this variable
            var_range <- range(model_results[[1]]$train_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
            
            # Create sequence of values
            var_seq <- seq(var_range[1], var_range[2], length.out = 50)
            
            # Create data frame with all other variables at their mean
            other_vars <- setdiff(names(model_results[[1]]$train_data), c("presence", "latitude", "longitude", var))
            
            # For each model, calculate response
            response_df <- data.frame(x = var_seq)
            
            for (result in model_results) {
                model_type <- result$model_type
                
                # Create prediction data frame
                pred_df <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(var_seq), ncol = length(other_vars)))
                names(pred_df) <- other_vars
                
                for (v in other_vars) {
                    pred_df[[v]] <- mean(result$train_data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
                }
                
                pred_df[[var]] <- var_seq
                
                # Make predictions
                if (model_type %in% c("glm", "rf", "gbm")) {
                    if (model_type == "glm") {
                        pred <- predict(result$model, newdata = pred_df, type = "response")
                    } else {
                        pred <- predict(result$model, newdata = pred_df, type = "prob")[,2]
                    }
                } else if (model_type == "maxent") {
                    pred <- predict(result$model, pred_df)
                }
                
                response_df[[paste0("y_", model_type)]] <- pred
            }
            
            # Calculate mean and confidence intervals
            response_df$y <- rowMeans(response_df[, grepl("^y_", names(response_df))])
            response_df$ymin <- apply(response_df[, grepl("^y_", names(response_df))], 1, min)
            response_df$ymax <- apply(response_df[, grepl("^y_", names(response_df))], 1, max)
            
            response_curves[[var]] <- response_df
        }
    }
    
    # Prepare threshold metrics (using the first model as example)
    threshold_metrics <- model_results[[1]]$metrics$threshold_metrics
    
    return(list(
        roc_data = roc_data,
        var_importance = var_importance,
        response_curves = response_curves,
        threshold_metrics = threshold_metrics,
        optimal_threshold = model_results[[1]]$metrics$optimal_threshold
    ))
}

# Main function to run the analysis
run_analysis <- function() {
    # Load environmental data
    env_stack <- load_environmental_data()
    
    # Process each species
    for (species in config$target_species) {
        cat("\nProcessing species:", species, "\n")
        
        # Load species data
        species_data <- load_species_data(species)
        
        if (is.null(species_data)) {
            cat("No data available for", species, "- skipping\n")
            next
        }
        
        # Prepare data for modeling
        model_data <- prepare_model_data(species_data, env_stack)
        
        if (nrow(model_data$train) == 0 || nrow(model_data$test) == 0) {
            cat("Insufficient data for", species, "- skipping\n")
            next
        }
        
        # Train and evaluate models
        model_results <- list()
        
        for (model_type in config$models_to_run) {
            cat("  Training", model_type, "model...\n")
            
            tryCatch({
                result <- train_model(model_type, model_data$train, model_data$test, species)
                
                # Project model to entire study area
                cat("  Projecting", model_type, "model...\n")
                result$projections <- project_model(result, env_stack)
                
                model_results[[model_type]] <- result
                
                cat("  Completed", model_type, "model\n")
            }, error = function(e) {
                cat("  Error in", model_type, "model:", e$message, "\n")
            })
        }
        
        if (length(model_results) == 0) {
            cat("No models successfully trained for", species, "- skipping\n")
            next
        }
        
        # Calculate evaluation metrics for all models
        model_evaluation <- calculate_model_evaluation(model_results)
        
        # Add evaluation data to each model result
        for (model_type in names(model_results)) {
            model_results[[model_type]]$roc_data <- model_evaluation$roc_data
            model_results[[model_type]]$var_importance <- model_evaluation$var_importance
            model_results[[model_type]]$response_curves <- model_evaluation$response_curves
            model_results[[model_type]]$threshold_metrics <- model_evaluation$threshold_metrics
            model_results[[model_type]]$optimal_threshold <- model_evaluation$optimal_threshold
        }
        
        # Run ensemble modeling
        cat("  Running ensemble modeling...\n")
        ensemble_projections <- run_ensemble(model_results, env_stack)
        
        # Save results
        saveRDS(model_results, file.path(config$output_dir, species, "model_results.rds"))
        saveRDS(ensemble_projections, file.path(config$output_dir, species, "ensemble_projections.rds"))
        
        # Create evaluation plots
        create_evaluation_plots(model_results[[1]], species)  # Using first model for evaluation plots
        
        # Create distribution maps for each model
        for (model_type in names(model_results)) {
            create_distribution_maps(model_results[[model_type]]$projections, 
                                    paste(species, model_type, sep = "_"), env_stack)
        }
        
        # Create ensemble distribution maps
        create_distribution_maps(ensemble_projections, paste(species, "ensemble", sep = "_"), env_stack)
        
        # Create summary report
        create_summary_report(model_results, ensemble_projections, species)
        
        cat("Completed processing for", species, "\n")
    }
    
    # Stop parallel processing
    stopCluster(cl)
}

# Function to create summary report
create_summary_report <- function(model_results, ensemble_projections, species_name) {
    # Create output directory for this species
    species_dir <- file.path(config$output_dir, species_name)
    
    # Prepare summary data
    summary_data <- list(
        species = species_name,
        models = names(model_results),
        evaluation_metrics = list(),
        ensemble = list(
            mean_area = cellSize(ensemble_projections$mean, unit = "km") * 
                          sum(values(ensemble_projections$mean) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            weighted_area = cellSize(ensemble_projections$weighted, unit = "km") * 
                            sum(values(ensemble_projections$weighted) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            binary_area = cellSize(ensemble_projections$binary, unit = "km") * 
                          sum(values(ensemble_projections$binary), na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    )
    
    # Collect evaluation metrics
    for (metric in config$evaluation_metrics) {
        summary_data$evaluation_metrics[[metric]] <- sapply(model_results, function(result) {
            result$metrics[[tolower(metric)]]$test
        })
    }
    
    # Add optimal thresholds
    summary_data$optimal_thresholds <- sapply(model_results, function(result) {
        result$metrics$optimal_threshold
    })
    
    # Save summary report
    writeLines(c(
        paste("Species Distribution Model Summary -", species_name),
        "",
        paste("Generated:", Sys.time()),
        "",
        "Model Evaluation Metrics:",
        "",
        capture.output(print(summary_data$evaluation_metrics)),
        "",
        "Optimal Thresholds:",
        "",
        capture.output(print(summary_data$optimal_thresholds)),
        "",
        "Predicted Distribution Areas (km²):",
        "",
        paste("Ensemble Mean:", format(summary_data$ensemble$mean_area, big.mark = ",")),
        paste("Ensemble Weighted:", format(summary_data$ensemble$weighted_area, big.mark = ",")),
        paste("Binary Prediction:", format(summary_data$ensemble$binary_area, big.mark = ","))
    ), file.path(species_dir, "summary_report.txt"))
    
    # Save as JSON for programmatic use
    writeLines(jsonlite::toJSON(summary_data, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE),
               file.path(species_dir, "summary_report.json"))
}

# Run the analysis
run_analysis()
